jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The **Program Coordinator** works in conjunction with the Program Director to implement the vision and mission of Marin Ventures. The Program Coordinator ensures that individuals receive high\-quality, person\-centered support that promotes independence, personal growth, and community participation. They are responsible for implementing program plans and services for participants, and managing and supervising Direct Support Professionals (DSPs). The Program Coordinator collaborates closely with participants, their support team members, program management staff, and direct care staff to foster a safe, inclusive, and positive environment.


**Marin Ventures is a community engagement day program for adults with developmental disabilities. Our mission is to foster independence and personal growth, and to promote the opportunity for community integration. We provide health and fitness activities, creative arts, computer and communication instruction, and independent living and employment skills training.**


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations regarding services for adults with developmental disabilities including reporting suspected abuse or neglect.
* Models best practices for staff in interacting with, supporting, and engaging participants.
* Implementation of program plans and services. Provides leadership and demonstrates team\-building skills.
* Develops and monitors daily activity schedule including special events and program vehicle use; coaches DSPs in developing lesson plans and daily schedules.
* Works with Program Director to develop staff training and development plans.
* Manages participant cases as assigned, including ISP development, case file review and updating, report writing, developing specific goals related to remote services and meeting attendance. Ensures that all documentation required by funding agencies is maintained.
* Determines participant goals through person\-centered planning team process, re\-sets objectives, and ensures that participants meet target goals.
* Evaluates participants' needs and exercises independent judgment regarding participant programs.
* Supervises DSPs and substitutes on floor as needed. Monitors job performance, completes performance evaluations and makes recommendations regarding employee discipline.
* Participates in staff recruitment. Interviews and evaluates employee candidates. Makes hiring recommendations to Program Director.
* Creates and implements remote activities and classes using remote technology, and supports and supervises DSPs in creating and implementing remote activities and classes.
* Trains DSPs on infection control, Covid\-19 protocols, and any other emerging emergency infection control protocols. As well as ensures protocols are being followed by DSPs.


**COMPETENCIES**


* Current CPR/FA/AED certification or ability to obtain certification.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience working with individuals with developmental disabilities in a community or day program setting is required.
* Minimum of 1 year of supervisory experience is highly preferred.
* Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written English communication skills.
* Work requires continual attention to detail in materials, establishing priorities, multi\-tasking and meeting deadlines.
* Must be proactive, self\-directing and project oriented.
* Must have current valid CA driver’s license and clean DMV record. Ability to drive agency vehicles as regular local travel may be required

**BENEFITS \& COMPENSATION**


* $28 \- $30 per hour
* Hours \- 7:00 am to 3:00 pm Monday through Friday, No nights, no weekends.
* Excellent benefits: Medical, dental, etc
* 10 Paid Holidays Annually
* Generous Paid Time Off
* Opportunity to develop skills in professional environment, and promotions for demonstrating leadership.
* A supportive and empathetic work culture and the opportunity to work with compassionate and mission\-driven people like yourself!


*Marin Ventures is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

jobs.title: DEVELOPMENTAL BEHAVIORAL HEALTH PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY OF POSITION:**




NEMS is looking for a Development Behavioral Health Program Coordinator to support the healthy development of children. They will be part of the team\-based approach to improve developmental and behavioral health. Pediatricians, Social Workers, and Family Engagement Specialists partner with families to ensure children have access to universal screening and early intervention services. This role is a critical member of the pediatric team, focusing on (1\) engaging parents, (2\) coordinating care, (3\) providing small group workshops on baby\-bonding and language development (4\) connecting families to services, (5\) advocating for families, and (6\) supporting optimal growth and development of children.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**




* Apply knowledge of early childhood development, effective school readiness strategies, and positive parenting skills to effectively deliver services
* Conduct face\-to\-face family intakes and needs assessments
* Engage with and support families in accessing developmental and behavioral services for their children.
* Engage collaboratively with community\-based agencies to assure continuity and coordination of care for patients.
* Provide case management and coordination services to families.
* Develop and support partnerships with external agencies and connect families to their services.
* Track and follow up external referrals.
* Partner with the Health Education team to deliver prenatal workshops and early literacy programs.
* Educate families about advocacy for their children.
* Advocate with service provider agencies to ensure timely and appropriate care for patients.
* Document clinical encounters and program information appropriately and in a timely manner.
* Ensure the quality dashboard in the follow\-up of high\-risk patients for the JVH Program.
* Perform other job duties as required by manager/supervisor.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**




* Bachelor’s degree in Child Development, Education, Social Work, or related field required
* Two (2\) \+ years of experience working with children and family services preferred
* Effective communication skills
* Current documentation of Basic Life Support is required.




**LANGUAGE:**




* Must be able to fluently speak, read and write English.
* Fluent in Chinese (Cantonese and/or Mandarin) required, Vietnamese, Spanish and other languages may be required depending on location.
* Fluency in other languages are an asset.

**STATUS:**




This is an FLSA Non\-exempt position.


This is not an OSHA high\-risk position.

jobs.title: Lead, Channel Enablement
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**


‎


Commercial Organization \| GTM Enablement  

Reports to: Director, GTM Enablement  

  

The Lead, Channel Enablement owns the enablement strategy and infrastructure that helps Castlight\-powered solutions get sold effectively through our channel ecosystem, including health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace relationships.  

  

This role is the Commercial owner of the second sale enablement motion and the connective tissue across Castlight, our partners, and the teams responsible for bringing our solutions to market. The Lead builds the training, demos, tools, and repeatable programs that allow partner sellers and Castlight teams to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Castlight\-powered solutions at scale.  

  

The role also owns the core demo infrastructure supporting channel selling, ensuring our Figma environments, screen libraries, and partner\-specific experiences stay current as the product evolves.
‎

**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**


‎

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Channel \& Partner Enablement**
---------------------------------

* Build and own the channel enablement strategy across health plans, strategic partners, resellers, and Marketplace partners.
* Develop scalable enablement programs that help partner sellers understand the buyer problem, articulate the Castlight value proposition, demonstrate the solution, and advance opportunities.
* Create partner\-ready training programs, playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, objection handling, templates, and selling tools using Product Marketing's approved positioning and messaging.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to build tailored enablement programs based on partner type, commercial model, seller audience, and go\-to\-market motion.
* Support the launch and ongoing readiness of new partner relationships and Castlight\-powered offerings.

**Second Sale Enablement**
--------------------------

* Own the enablement framework for the second sale motion across health plan and partner channels.
* Establish one source of truth for second sale training, demos, tools, templates, and selling standards.
* Prepare Castlight Commercial and Client teams for the transition of second sale execution to Client CSMs by September 30\.
* Build repeatable training and certification approaches that allow Client teams to execute consistently while maintaining Commercial standards.
* Create scalable processes for Commercial review, feedback, and continuous improvement as execution moves closer to the client and health plan teams.

**Demo Strategy \& Engineering**
--------------------------------

* Own the core demo environments supporting health plan, partner, reseller, and second sale motions.
* Build and maintain Figma\-based demos, screen libraries, reusable components, and partner\-specific demo experiences.
* Maintain demo environments as products, capabilities, positioning, and user experiences evolve.
* Lead Nova conversions across the existing channel book and establish the standards for new partner implementations.
* Manage partner access to demo environments and establish clear governance around version control, usage, and updates.
* Coordinate external design or Figma resources as needed to maintain and scale the demo platform.
* Establish a regular operating cadence with Product, UX, Solutions, and Product Marketing so demo experiences remain accurate and current.

**Cross\-Functional Enablement**
--------------------------------

* Translate Product Marketing's positioning and messaging into usable seller training, demos, and field tools.
* Partner with Strategic Partnerships to understand partner priorities, seller needs, and commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Client leadership to ensure second sale teams have the tools, training, and confidence required to execute.
* Partner with Solutions and Product teams to keep demonstrations accurate and identify opportunities to improve how Castlight capabilities are represented in market.
* Bring health plan, partner, seller, and field feedback back to Product Marketing, Product, Solutions, and Strategic Partnerships to improve messaging, products, and the partner experience.

**How Ownership Works**
-----------------------

This role operates across several teams, with clear ownership boundaries:

**Product Marketing** owns core positioning, messaging architecture, value propositions, competitive strategy, and master marketing assets.

**Channel Enablement** turns that strategy into training, demos, playbooks, tools, certification, and scalable seller experiences.

**Strategic Partnerships** owns partner strategy, relationships, commercial agreements, partner performance, and escalations.

**Client CSMs** own plan\-specific second sale execution, including training delivery to health plan sellers and ongoing maintenance of client\-specific materials.

**Solutions and Product** provide product expertise, roadmap input, and validation required to keep demonstrations technically accurate.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Partner sellers can confidently explain and demonstrate Castlight\-powered solutions without relying on Castlight for every selling interaction.
* Health plan and partner channels have consistent, current, easy\-to\-use enablement resources.
* Second sale execution successfully transitions to Client teams without losing quality or commercial consistency.
* Demo environments stay aligned with the live product and can be efficiently adapted across partners and channels.
* New partners can move from agreement to seller readiness through a repeatable enablement process.
* Feedback from partner and second sale motions consistently reaches the teams responsible for product, messaging, and commercial strategy.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection & Response)
jobs.description:
### **About Point**


**✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.


**✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.


**✨ Game\-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4\.7 Trustpilot rating and an A\+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000\+ customers.


**✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.


**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S., while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people\-first culture.

  


**Local or 100% Remote**

  


While this role is remote, candidates located near our Palo Alto headquarters are preferred and will have opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues in person approximately once per week.

  


**About the role**



Point Digital Finance is expanding its Information Security function, and this is the team's first dedicated monitoring and response hire — a high\-visibility role with immediate, measurable impact. As Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection \& Response), you will be the second half of an incident\-response rotation, partnering directly with the security lead to detect, investigate, and contain threats across a regulated consumer\-finance environment that protects the financial data of hundreds of thousands of homeowners. This is not an alert\-watching seat: you will engineer the detections, automate the response, and harden how we see our AWS, Google Workspace, and SaaS estate. You'll help stand up a modern detection \& response practice from an early\-stage footing, with the autonomy to own problems end to end and the mandate to turn noisy alerts into fast, repeatable, well\-documented response. If you like building as much as responding — and want your work to directly reduce risk to real people's financial lives — this role is for you.



Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team!

  


**Your responsibilities**


* **Rotate on\-call and lead response:** share the 24/7 on\-call and incident\-response rotation with the security lead — triaging, investigating, and driving containment of security alerts and incidents.
* **Own response documentation:** build and maintain incident\-response runbooks, escalation paths, and post\-incident reviews so response is consistent and repeatable.
* **Engineer detections:** build, tune, and maintain SIEM detections, correlation rules, dashboards, and reporting in Coralogix across cloud and identity log sources.
* **Close coverage gaps:** reduce false positives and onboard new log sources to eliminate detection blind spots.
* **Own vulnerability management:** run day\-to\-day vulnerability management — prioritize findings, coordinate remediation with system owners, and report on risk reduction across cloud and endpoints.
* **Automate response:** develop detection\-as\-code and lightweight automation/SOAR so common alerts self\-triage and response is faster and repeatable.
* **Add operational redundancy:** serve as a redundant administrative and response path so containment is never bottlenecked on a single person.
* **Report and evidence:** produce recurring security metrics and reporting for leadership, and supply control evidence for audits.
* **Apply AI to the workflow:** use AI/LLM tooling to accelerate investigation, correlation, and detection engineering.
* **Improve the program:** contribute to continuous improvement of the security\-operations program, tooling, and threat monitoring.

  


**About you**


* 5\+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, SOC, or detection engineering (mid\-to\-senior individual contributor).
* Hands\-on experience running or actively participating in an on\-call / incident\-response rotation, independently.
* Strong SIEM skills — authoring and tuning detections, correlation rules, and dashboards (Coralogix, Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, or similar).
* Practical cloud security experience in AWS and Google Workspace, including identity and log sources.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate and contain incidents end to end — e.g., phishing/AiTM, account takeover, business email compromise, and cloud/identity threats.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management and coordinating remediation with engineering teams.
* Scripting and automation ability (Python or similar) for detection\-as\-code and SOAR\-style workflows.
* Clear written and verbal communication — able to produce runbooks, metrics, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Comfortable operating with autonomy on a small team and owning problems end to end.
* Authorized to work in the United States, and able to participate in an off\-hours on\-call rotation.


**Nice to have**


* Hands\-on experience using AI/LLMs for security analysis, investigation, and alert engineering (detection authoring, correlation, tuning, and automation).
* Experience in a regulated financial\-services or fintech environment (GLBA, NYDFS Part 500, SOC 2\).
* Relevant certifications (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GCED, GIAC, CySA\+, Security\+, or AWS Security Specialty).
* Experience standing up detection \& response practices from an early or greenfield state.

* Build and manage operational dashboards that surface where deals are progressing, stalling, or at risk.
* Define and maintain metric standards (e.g., pipeline stages, pacing benchmarks, utilization rates) to ensure consistent reporting across the team.

* Partner with Data and Engineering to automate manual reporting workflows, moving the team toward real\-time dashboards.

* Document and systematize repeatable operational processes — from media plan intake to campaign pacing to client reporting.
* Identify bottlenecks across the Brands ops workflow and drive resolution in partnership with Product and Engineering.
* Identify opportunities to leverage tooling to reduce manual work and speed up decision\-making.

* 8\+ years of experience in revenue operations, programmatic, sales operations, or a related function within digital advertising or media.
* Strong analytical skills; comfortable building and interpreting pipeline models, pacing dashboards, and funnel analyses. SQL or equivalent data querying experience a plus.
* Experience designing and running a rhythm of business (WBR, QBR, or equivalent) for a sales or revenue\-generating team.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear executive narratives and drive decisions across senior stakeholders.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills; able to drive alignment across Sales, Product, Finance, and Operations.

jobs.title: GTM Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

As a GTM Sales Operations Manager for Contact Data Management, you are a highly motivated self\-starter responsible for driving critical contact data quality and acquisition initiatives in Salesforce across our global GTM organization. This role combines strategic execution with hands\-on technical leadership, leveraging agentic, autonomous, and analytical Al solutions to systematically standardize, enrich, deduplicate, and acquire high\-propensity contact records at scale. You will ensure high\-value accounts always have relevant, actionable contact data that drives Sales prospecting effectiveness, accelerates pipeline velocity, and directly impacts revenue growth across global GTM operations.  

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior GTM Data Governance Director.  

**Responsibility**
* Execute global contact standardization, enrichment, and deduplication initiatives with accountability for contact accuracy, completeness, and coverage across all regions
* Develop and enforce contact data standards, governance policies, and contact\-to\-account hierarchy rules aligned with global compliance requirements and regional privacy regulations
* Build and maintain contact data quality dashboards with monthly KPI tracking and executive visibility to Sales and GTM leadership; establish SLAs and performance benchmarks for contact accuracy, completeness, and coverage
* Ensure contact data readiness for sales enablement drive clean, standardized contact creation and enrichment at the point of entry to prevent downstream quality issues
* Design and deploy Al agents and automation workflows to standardize, enrich, validate, and deduplicate contact records\-targeting 99%\+ data accuracy and completeness
* Architect intelligent contact data pipelines and validation frameworks; build scalable, production\-grade contact data standards with automated quality assurance processes
* Identify, evaluate, and implement emerging data technologies and AI/ML solutions to improve contact quality, operational efficiency, and scalability
* Deploy multiple Al/automation workflows that reduce manual cleansing and enrichment effort and accelerate time\-to\-productivity for regional teams
* Drive contact acquisition strategy leveraging Clay, ZoomInfo, Lusha, Cognism and similar platforms to maximize new contact coverage and ensure high\-propensity accounts have relevant contacts for prospecting
* Lead hands\-on vendor selection, integration, relationship management, and continuous optimization for contact coverage; manage vendor SLAs and performance monitoring
* Execute contact deduplication and contact hierarchy initiatives across global regions; eliminate duplicate and orphaned contacts to improve data trust scores
* Increase complete contact coverage (first name, last name, email, phone, title) by through targeted enrichment, validation, and process improvements
* Write business requirements documents (BRDs) and technical specifications for contact data quality initiatives, automation workflows, and GTM system enhancements
* Coordinate closely with internal team to ensure technical feasibility, security compliance, and alignment with data infrastructure standards
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new contact systems, automation tools, and process changes; validate solutions meet global business requirements
* Participate in prioritization sessions to assess business impact of contact data initiatives and ensure resources are allocated to highest\-value opportunities
* Partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations, RevOps, Marketing Operations, and GTM teams to understand contact requirements and drive adoption of contact data standards
* Communicate contact data quality insights and strategic recommendations to Sales and C\-level GTM leadership through compelling presentations, dashboards, and executive reports
* Coordinate execution with central data governance team, regional stakeholders, and offshore contractors to deliver consistent, high\-quality contact data improvements
* Lead offshore team performance management, training, quality assurance, and process optimization
* Provide regular updates on contact data quality goals, progress against KPIs, improvements made, and impact to Sales effectiveness and revenue outcomes
* Prioritize contact data initiatives based on maximum business impact\-focusing resources and effort on high\-propensity accounts, priority segments, and activities with highest ROI to Sales prospecting, pipeline acceleration, and revenue growth
* Execute cross\-functional contact data programs with defined KPIs, milestones, and stakeholder visibility (contact segmentation, territory enablement, forecasting readiness)
* Support global GTM planning with clean, standardized, enriched contact data and account\-to\-contact mapping
* Establish contact data SLAs and achieve 98%\+ compliance across all regions; improve contact data accuracy to 95%\+ and achieve 90%\+ contact coverage within 12 months

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week

jobs.title: Program Manager, Global Infrastructure and Energy, Business Operations
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

The application window will be open until at least September 17, 2026\. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Thornton, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management, business operations, or a related field.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with data analysis, utilizing metrics to track performance and drive decision\-making.
* Experience leveraging data analysis or AI tools to build dashboards, streamline business operations, and drive cross\-functional decision\-making.
* Experience in stakeholder management and executing communication strategies across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience independently managing the full lifecycle of cross\-functional programs with minimal guidance.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Global Infrastructure and Energy organization is responsible to deliver the infrastructure to host and connect every machine and every user on the internet, with Carbon Free Energy (CFE). As part of the Commercial and Business Operations arm within the Global Operations for Assets and Tooling team, we are responsible to help leadership run the business, and support the strategic negotiators land deals quickly and be able to maximize our returns.


As a Business Operations Program Manager, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and improving our team's daily operational rhythm. You will build and manage essential reporting dashboards, track various business and organization metrics, and leverage AI to improve our business operations. By providing steady support for ad hoc requests and standardizing processes, you will enable our team to operate at its highest potential.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $132000 \- $189000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain routine operational reports and dashboards to provide team leadership and stakeholders with clear visibility into key business metrics.
* Manage the internal team website and training materials, ensuring all resources, documentation, and processes are accurate, organized, and easily accessible.
* Track and reconcile approved headcount grants against open staffing requests, maintaining accurate roster data to support hiring workflows and capacity planning.
* Identify opportunities to streamline day\-to\-day business operations, leveraging AI tools and standardizing basic team processes to resolve bottlenecks.
* Provide ongoing support for daily operational tasks and ad hoc reporting requests, helping the team address immediate needs and maintain a steady operational rhythm.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Imagine a company that recognizes excellence in not only the products it sells, but also in its employees. R.S. Hughes Company, Inc. is that company. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of quality and professionalism — and we treat our employees like the valuable assets they are.



Founded in 1954, R.S. Hughes Co., Inc. is a dynamic, North American distributor of industrial supplies. With over 40 warehouse sites in the United States and Mexico, we maintain an extensive inventory of adhesives, abrasives, electrical, static control, tapes, labeling and safety products.



In addition to competitive salaries and benefits, we offer an environment that asks you to make a difference. We value hard work and common sense, and we consistently reward those that exemplify these traits. If you're looking for a great team to grow with and if you are willing to embrace the challenges of being expected to be the best, we welcome you to come join the R.S. Hughes Company, Inc. team!


**Position Description**



At R.S. Hughes, the Senior Operations Manager will lead a cross\-functional team across an assigned region and direct activities related to business operations. The Senior Operations Manager will take a hands\-on approach; being committed to expanding and strengthening the business. This role will implement strategies that increase productivity and enable achievement of sales targets. The Senior Operations Manager is expected to adhere to all company policies and safety protocols.


**Core Responsibilities****:**


* Ensure the business delivers against profit and loss requirements within the current operational plan framework, while uncovering ad hoc opportunities to drive revenue and profit growth.
* Accelerate business growth through strategic and operational plans and activities; drive continuous advancement in business development to increase top\-line and bottom\-line growth rates.
* Build an operating culture of understanding and cohesiveness, while fostering and empowering entrepreneurialism at local levels to uncover and seize opportunities; provide transformational thinking to raise performance and service delivery.
* Oversee talent development programs and actions to enhance organizational capabilities, especially for warehouse operations roles.
* Manage the planning and deployment of capital as appropriate for the region.
* Establish yourself quickly as a leader with in\-depth insight into the business model and the nuances of each division; present the model in terms of business value to various constituencies.
* Foster a culture of transparency, disciplined problem\-solving, high\-performance work teams, and continuous improvement; ensure the right team, tools, and processes are in place to support these traits.
* Coach, provide feedback to, and develop divisional Warehouse Managers and Operation Managers; motivate and manage performance to achieve annual regional and organizational goals/objectives.
* Maintain quality service by enforcing quality and operational standards; analyze and resolve quality/service\-delivery issues; identify trends; recommend system improvements.
* Make business decisions that are financially responsible, accountable, justifiable, and defensible in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Establish and maintain relevant controls and feedback systems to monitor warehouse and regional operations.
* Review performance data (financial, sales, and activity reports/spreadsheets) to monitor and measure departmental productivity, goal achievement, and overall effectiveness.
* Perform other job duties as assigned.
* Must be able to travel up to 40% consistently.


**Education/Certification/Licenses**


* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field.
* Minimum of 5–7 years of relevant experience in a sizable division management role, including Operations, Sales Operations and/or Customer Service within the R.S. Hughes Company, Inc., or similar experience. The ideal team member will understand all aspects of the R.S. Hughes Company, Inc. This includes, but is not limited to, Customer Care, Warehouse, Logistics, Operations, Credit \& Collect \& Finance. (Required)


**Skills That Will Make You Successful**

* Communication
* Attention to detail
* Problem solving
* Relationship building
* Strong leadership skills; business acumen; solid analytical and strategic thinking.
* Change leadership: Willingness to foster, lead, and incorporate change.
* Decision\-making: Strong decision maker and effective mediator of conflicts between peers and direct reports.


**Compensation**



Our merit\-based salary/bonus program offers exceptional growth opportunities. We provide a comprehensive medical, dental, life insurance, wellness benefit, short term disability plan, paid vacation, and a 401(k) retirement savings plan, and an Employee Stock Ownership Program (ESOP), where employees are eligible after 30 days of service.



Compensation for this exempt role is up to $84,000 DOE

#### **Experience**


Required* 5 \- 7 years: Relevant experience in a sizable division management role, including Operations, Sales Operations and/or Customer Service

#### **Education**


Required* Bachelors or better in Business Administration or related field


Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

jobs.title: Accounting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Catharos is a Series A\-funded stealth climate tech company developing a novel approach to direct air capture of CO₂, preparing to move from bench\-scale validation to pilot\-scale demonstration. Catharos is hiring a hands\-on Accounting Operations Manager to own the day\-to\-day financial operations of the company — bookkeeping, accounts payable, purchasing coordination, vendor administration, payroll, and expense management. The company is currently pre\-revenue, so the near term focus is on expenses, payables, cash activity, purchasing, and maintaining accurate books and records. You'll work closely with company leadership and our outsourced controller, and you'll help build the financial processes and systems the company needs as it grows.

**Responsibilities**

* Own day\-to\-day bookkeeping and transaction processing, including accounts payable from invoice receipt through payment, expense coding, and bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Serve as the internal point of contact for our outsourced controller, preparing the reconciliations, schedules, and documentation needed for month\-end and year\-end close and helping implement accounting policies and controls.
* Administer payroll, corporate cards, and employee expense processes, and monitor recurring spend and subscriptions.
* Manage the company side of day\-to\-day purchasing: coordinating purchase requests and approvals, matching purchase orders, receiving, and invoices, tracking open orders, deposits, and commitments, and serving as the point of escalation for purchasing issues.
* Maintain vendor records and onboarding documentation, reconcile vendor statements, resolve invoice and purchase order discrepancies, and support 1099 preparation.
* Process vendor and intercompany payments across our US and international entities and maintain a clear view of cash activity and upcoming payment obligations
* Help build the accounting, purchasing, and expense processes the company needs as it grows, including inventory tracking and cost accounting support as manufacturing develops.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on bookkeeping, accounting, or financial operations experience, including accounts payable and general ledger work.–
* Strong understanding of bookkeeping and accounting principles, with hands\-on experience across reconciliations and month\-end close support.
* Experience with cloud accounting systems and strong spreadsheet skills.–
* Excellent attention to detail and follow\-through, with the ability to create structure around processes and information.
* Comfort working independently and taking ownership alongside an outsourced controller and external accountants.–
* Comfort in an early\-stage environment where processes are still being built and responsibilities evolve.
* Ability to work full\-time onsite, with hybrid flexibility possible in Palo Alto until our Oakland facility opens.

**Strongly Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at an early\-stage or venture\-backed company, ideally pre\-revenue or in product development.
* Procurement, purchasing, or vendor management experience, including purchase orders and invoice matching.
* Experience with international vendors, cross\-border payments, or suppliers in China or Southeast Asia.
* Experience supporting inventory or cost accounting at a hardware or manufacturing company.
* Experience implementing or improving accounting, expense, or procurement systems and processes.
* A degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.
* Compensation Competitive salary and equity commensurate with experience.
* Details discussed during the interview process.

Pay: $78,280\.83 \- $94,273\.68 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oakland, CA 94604

Embarc seeks an experienced, self\-motivated, and organized leader to be our full\-time **Sales and Operations Manager** at our cannabis dispensary. Embarc is an emerging cannabis retailer, passionate about our community, customers, and people. If you are excited about retail leadership, read below \- we invite you to apply.


**What is the Job?**



The Sales and Operations Manager oversees all **Customer Experience and Sales Initiatives** while also managing store operations, leading the team, and supporting inventory operations. This role requires a laser\-like focus on all aspects of the customer experience, driving sales, community engagement, strong leadership, organizational skills, and strict compliance with company policies and state regulations.

* Leads the front of house store team to create an exceptional experience for customers and employees, and to exceed sales goals.
* Engage with customers on the sales floor, answering questions and recommending products.
* Champion brand education and product knowledge training.
* Analyze sales metrics and employee performance to drive business results.
* Build customer retention using company loyalty programs.
* Lead the communication and execution of sales and marketing initiatives.
* Execute visual merchandising to uphold company standards.
* Lead community engagement, field marketing, and events.
* Manage customer reviews across all platforms.


**Store Operations:**


* Supervise daily store operations to ensure efficiency and compliance.
* Oversee opening and closing procedures, cash handling, and merchandising.
* Support the implementation of company policies, legal regulations, and operational improvements.
* Ensure that facility issues are rectified to provide an excellent customer experience.

* Act as a PPSO as needed.

* Mentor, train, and coach team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning, development, and accountability.
* Act as a key point of contact between store management and staff.

* Build a culture that aligns with the core values of the organization.
* Utilize critical problem\-solving skills to make decisions for the store.
* Be a champion of change.

* Strong leadership and communication skills with both staff and vendors.
* Deep understanding of customer experience and driving of sales

* Ability to lead and motivate a team in a fast\-paced retail environment.

**Required Education and Experience:**


* Proven track record of utilizing training and resources to drive a culture of exceptional customer experience and sales.
* Experience with **Treez POS system**.
* At least **two years of management or supervisory experience in retail or operations**.
* Experience with computerized inventory and compliance systems.


**Expected Hours of Work:**



This is a full\-time exempt role in a retail store open 365 days a year. Evening, weekend, and holiday shifts are required based on business needs.


**Benefits:**


* Health, dental, vision, and life insurance
* Paid time off
* Employee discounts
* Professional development support

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


The Business Operations Manager (BOM) will be responsible for working closely with the Program Manager (PM) and Senior Business Operations Manager in the coordination and tracking of all activities related to contract operation. The BOM will assist with administrative, personnel, fiscal, travel, logistical, training, equipment and other duties as assigned.


The BOM will work onsite at NASA Ames in Mountain View, California.


Hybrid schedule is available


Salary range: $100,000 to $140,000

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Take ownership of program activities as a regular, integral part of contract operations, which may include tracking and coordinating activities on many fronts, assessing situations/issues that may arise and effectively discussing recommended course of action with the PM and Sr. Business Operations Manager.
* Prepare and update project plans and status reports and implement lessons learned.
* Build and maintain working relationships with team members, vendors, and corporate operations.
* Coordinate with corporate infrastructure to clearly define roles, work sharing, and effective workflow.
* Manage, maintain, and archive operations data and records, including site performance metrics, contact DRDs and all forms of contract reporting and operations information.
* Work with AMA Contracts/Procurements to track procurements and subcontracting to ensure appropriate documentation is maintained, agreements are in place and spending tasks are aligned with the plan.
* Coordinate and communicate effectively with technical and administrative staff members to address operational efficiency or emerging issues.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Kai is the AI company rebuilding cybersecurity for the machine\-speed era. Founded by second\-time founders and trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, Kai is building a future where security has no categories, no silos, and no human speed bottlenecks. The Kai Autonomous Defense Platform replaces fragmented, human\-limited workflows with agentic AI systems that continuously contextualize, assess, reason, and execute security work at machine speed, making human defenders superhuman.


**Why Kai?**


* **Well\-funded:** $125M raised, with the capital, runway, and resolve to rebuild cybersecurity from first principles.
* **Proven:** We've earned the trust of Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, and we're just getting started. Their confidence in Kai reflects what we've built: an AI\-native cybersecurity platform that performs at machine speed with human\-expert accuracy.
* **Experienced founders:** Our founding team are second\-time entrepreneurs, each with 20\+ years in cybersecurity. They've built and scaled before, and they're doing it again with a bigger vision.
* **Competitive compensation:** Highly competitive salary, meaningful equity, and a culture where your contributions are recognized and rewarded as we grow.
**The Role:**
  

Most marketing operations roles are archaeology. You inherit ten years of someone else's decisions: orphaned fields, four competing definitions of an MQL, attribution nobody trusts, a routing rule from 2019 that no one will let you turn off, and you spend your tenure negotiating with the past.


This is not that role.


This is the first marketing operations hire at Kai. There is no technical debt to service and no legacy CRM to appease. You get HubSpot, an AI\-native CRM, a fast\-growing enterprise pipeline, and a blank sheet of paper.


Reporting to the Head of GTM Operations, you will define marketing operations at Kai. You will own and build out the data model, the lifecycle, the campaign framework, the routing engine, and the measurement layer that ties every dollar of marketing spend to pipeline and revenue. You'll set the standards the rest of the GTM organization builds on for the next five years.


And you'll build it the way it should be built now, not the way it was built a decade ago. We are an AI company. We expect the systems running our go\-to\-market to be as AI\-native as the platform we sell to our customers. That means agents and automation doing the work marketing ops teams have historically done with manual list uploads, spreadsheet reconciliation, and late\-night heroics. You won't be retrofitting AI onto a broken system. You'll be designing the system AI should have been built into from day one.
  

  

If you have strong opinions about how lifecycle, attribution, and routing should work, and you've been waiting for a seat where you get to act on them instead of defending them, this is that seat.  

  



**What You'll Bring:**


* 5–8 years in Marketing Operations, GTM Engineering, or Revenue Operations,Deep, hands\-on HubSpot expertise

A real philosophy on AI\-native operations. Data modeling fluency. Ability to build multi\-touch attribution with cross\-functional credibility.  

* 

**What You'll Do:**


* Own the marketing data model across the marketing automation platform and Sales CRM
* Manage the person\-to\-account architecture: deduplication, hierarchy handling, and buying\-group logic
* Support the enrichment and data\-quality layer with AI\-driven waterfalls, automated validation, and monitoring
* Manage the governance model: naming conventions, field ownership, change control, and privacy/GDPR
* Define source, sourcing, and influence rules that Marketing, Sales, and Finance all sign off on, and enforce them in the system
* Operationalize events, webinars, field programs, and partner motions end to end capture, enrichment, QA, upload, follow\-up, and attribution leveraging AI
* Instrument the website and digital properties for conversion tracking, UTM discipline, and form/progressive\-profiling strategy
* Build campaign performance reporting Use AI to score, qualify, research, and enrich inbound before a human ever touches it.
* Support SLA tracking, working\-status enforcement, recycle and re\-entry logic, and alerting for every break in the chain
* Instrument lifecycle stages and track conversion rates and cycle times
* Support the creation of ABM and account\-based plays: target account lists, buying\-group orchestration, and coordinated multi\-threaded outreach
* Deliver marketing\-sourced and marketing\-influenced pipeline reporting

jobs.title: Operations Manager-Permitting
jobs.description:

As a 100% employee\-owned company for over 70 years, our experts bring integrity, accountability, and innovation to everything we do. Our culture fosters collaboration, growth, and shared success—creating meaningful work while building the networks that connect communities and power the future.

 **We are seeking**a **Permitting Operations Manager** who is accountable for the overall strategy, execution, and performance of the Permitting function. This role leads end‑to‑end permitting operations across multiple projects and customers, ensuring permit packages are accurate, compliant, timely, and financially sound. The Manager owns departmental workflows, capacity planning, subcontractor strategy, quality controls, and performance outcomes while serving as a key partner to Engineering, Operations, Business Development, and customers. This position is responsible for building a scalable, data driven permitting organization that supports both current delivery and long\-term growth objectives.

 **Responsibilities**

  

* Own and lead the day‑to‑day and strategic execution of permitting operations, ensuring accurate, compliant permit packages are produced and submitted on time across all projects.
* Establish, document, and enforce standardized workflows, quality controls, and production expectations for in‑house teams and subcontractors.
* Ensure permitting milestones align with project schedules, customer SLAs, and contractual commitments.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements that reduce cycle time, rework, and regulatory risk.
* Leverage data, dashboards, and metrics to improve first‑pass approval rates, throughput, and overall department performance.
* Maintain permitting processes and proactively address regulatory or compliance changes.
* Own departmental resourcing and staffing strategies, including hiring, onboarding, and utilization of in‑house staff and subcontractors to align with workload demands and growth objectives.
* Oversee department financial performance, supporting budgeting, tracking labor and subcontractor costs, improving margin performance through operational efficiencies, and ensuring work is executed within approved financial parameters.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for key customers, providing transparent status updates, issue resolution, and escalation management.
* Participate in regular client reviews, quality discussions, and performance governance forums.
* Collaborate with Business Development to support proposals, including scope definition, resourcing strategies, schedules, and permitting risk assessments.
* Partner with Engineering and cross‑functional leadership to ensure effective information flow, alignment on priorities, and execution of shared departmental goals and operational objectives.
* Lead, coach, and develop managers and team members, fostering accountability, engagement, and professional growth.
* Conduct performance reviews, goal‑setting, and development planning aligned with departmental and company objectives.
* Build bench strength and succession capability to support long‑term departmental stability and scalability.
* Ensure confidentiality of company information.
* Individuals in this role receive privileged access and are assigned specialized training at least once a year.
* Perform other related duties assigned by management.

 **Qualifications**

  

* 6\+ years of progressive leadership experience in permitting operations across DOT, railroad, utilities, municipal, or similar environments.
* Bachelor’s or Associate degree in Engineering, Business, Communications, or related field preferred.
* 8\+ years of management experience across diverse permitting processes preferred.
* Deep understanding of production‑based permitting workflows from design intake to approval.
* Working knowledge of aerial and underground utility design and construction principles.
* Proven ability to lead managers, teams, and subcontractors in fast‑paced, high‑volume environments.
* Demonstrated success driving accountability, performance improvement, and change.
* Strong proficiency in Dynamics 365 or comparable enterprise workflow systems.
* Experience leveraging Power BI, Excel, or similar tools to monitor KPIs, capacity, quality, and financial performance.
* Strong leadership qualities to motivate, direct, and support survey crew members.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management software.
* Ability to embrace corporate values, understand the company mission, and exemplify CCI leadership behaviors.
* Additional education or training in GIS, surveying technology, or related fields (preferred).
* Experience performing subsurface utility engineering (SUE) investigations (preferred).
* Experience with ground‑based terrestrial mapping and aerial mapping (preferred).

 **Additional Information**

* Travel up to 20%
* Must have a valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record

jobs.title: Project Manager - Service
jobs.description:
The Service Project Manager (SPM) is responsible for managing HVAC and plumbing service projects from initial estimation through final completion. This includes small repairs, major retrofits, and large\-scale service installations. The SPM ensures projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with customer expectations and company standards. The SPM serves as the key point of contact between clients, internal teams, vendors, and subcontractors—coordinating all project phases while maintaining compliance with safety, building codes, and company procedures.

  



**Responsibilities**

* Analyze project requirements and customer needs to develop accurate cost estimates for HVAC and plumbing service work, including repairs, replacements, and retrofits.
* Review drawings, specifications, and other documents to determine project scope and material requirements.
* Collaborate with service technicians, project managers, and sales teams to ensure estimates align with operational capabilities and customer expectations.
* Actively mentor assigned support personnel.
* Source and evaluate multiple vendor quotes for equipment, materials, and subcontractor services to ensure cost\-effective solutions.
* Prepare comprehensive proposals that outline labor, materials, and overhead costs, ensuring alignment with company pricing strategies and industry standards.
* Communicate with customers to clarify project details, answer questions, and provide recommendations to optimize system performance and cost efficiency.
* Track and manage bid deadlines, revisions, and approvals, ensuring timely and accurate submission of estimates.
* Oversee post\-estimate project handoff, providing clear scope, schedule \& budget details to field personnel and service teams.
* Manage HVAC and plumbing service projects from planning to completion, ensuring on\-time and on\-budget delivery.
* Coordinate with labor force leadership to ensure seamless project execution.
* Monitor project progress, managing any challenges to maintain efficiency and quality standards.
* Manage multiple projects and bid opportunities simultaneously.
* Utilize company CRM, bid, and project management platforms.
* Create a detailed schedule that aligns with customer expectations, equipment lead times, and field team availability.
* Communicate with customers throughout the project lifecycle, providing updates, ensuring satisfaction, and addressing concerns.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, industry standards, and company policies.
* Oversee procurement of materials, equipment, and labor resources for assigned projects.
* Track project costs and manage profitability, adjusting as necessary to stay within budget.
* Maintain accurate documentation, including contracts, change orders, and project reports.
* Prepare required closeout package.
* Stay informed about industry trends, new technologies, and best practices to improve service operations.
* Coordinate with Area Supervisors and Foremen to schedule projects, maintenance, and repairs efficiently.
* Drive personal sales goals.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, industrial, etc.), Construction Management, or related field experience.
* 5\-7 or more years of work experience in project engineering in HVAC, MEP, or construction.
* Extensive knowledge of HVAC systems, plumbing, ductwork, piping, refrigeration, and energy efficiency solutions.
* Deep understanding of HVAC and plumbing systems, service processes, and industry standards.
* Digitally savvy, including excellent PC application skills and the ability to quickly learn numerous custom software applications.
* Proficiency in estimating and project management software (e.g., Procore, Bluebeam, Fast Pipe, \& Fast Duct).
* Familiarity with HVAC load calculations and system design.

**Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and competing deadlines.
* Effective negotiation and contract management skills.
* Confident decision\-making and conflict resolution abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Team leadership, delegation, and accountability.
* Persuasive communication to support proposals and drive project buy\-in.
* Accuracy in estimates, documentation, and compliance tracking.
* Commitment to professional growth and ongoing learning.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites.


An effective and successful Service Project Manager is a highly organized and detail\-oriented professional who excels in overseeing HVAC and plumbing service projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. They possess a strong combination of technical knowledge, leadership skills, and customer service expertise.

*United Mechanical is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. We provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.*

jobs.description:
**Program Manager**

**Palo Alto \| Hybrid**


NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, is based in Silicon Valley. We develop AI products that operationalize AI across enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. We partner with other NTT companies (NTT DATA Inc., NTT DATA Japan, and NTT DOCOMO) to ensure successful deployment to NTT clients. Our clients benefit from AIVista’s deep AI product expertise combined with the industry domain knowledge and systems integration experience of NTT DATA.

**Role Description**


We are seeking a highly organized, execution\-oriented **Program Manager** to support and scale critical internal operations across HR, Finance, and other corporate functions while helping drive the adoption of agentified workflows across the organization.


This role will work closely with executive and functional leaders to coordinate high\-priority programs, strengthen operational processes, and ensure cross\-functional initiatives move from planning through execution. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment, managing sensitive information, creating structure where needed, and identifying opportunities to improve how work gets done through automation and AI.

**Core Responsibilities**

Partner with the CAO and HR function to coordinate day\-to\-day people programs and operational initiatives, including:

* Manage employee lifecycle workflows, including onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, and HR records.
* Support recruiting operations, hiring approvals, offer processes, background checks, and headcount tracking.
* Support the development and ongoing management of internal knowledge resources and the company intranet.
* Coordinate compliance requirements, mandatory employee training, documentation, and operational tracking.
* Support internal audit and compliance\-readiness initiatives across HR and other corporate functions.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee and manager experiences through stronger processes, systems, automation, and programs.

**2\. Finance Operations**


Partner with the CFO and Finance function to coordinate and support key financial and business operations, including:

* Support budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and preparation of leadership and Board\-level finance updates.

* Coordinate cross\-functional finance initiatives and ensure owners, dependencies, deadlines, and deliverables remain on track.

**3\. Agentified Internal Operations**


Help identify, design, implement, and continuously improve AI\-enabled workflows across Finance, HR, Legal, Marketing, and other internal functions to drive operational excellence.

* Identify operational workflows that can be streamlined, automated, or improved through AI agents and other AI\-enabled tools.
* Partner with functional owners to understand and document workflows, decision points, permissions, dependencies, and success criteria.
* Translate business processes into clear agent instructions, workflows, checklists, escalation paths, and user guidance.
* Coordinate implementation and adoption of AI\-enabled workflows across internal teams.
* Monitor outputs for accuracy, completeness, privacy, and business appropriateness.
* Establish feedback loops and operational metrics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Train and support internal users as new AI\-enabled capabilities and workflows are introduced.

**Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in program management, business operations, finance operations, HR operations, Chief of Staff, or a related role.
* Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross\-functional programs from planning through execution.
* Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Working knowledge of finance operations, HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, and internal business controls.
* Strong operational judgment and the ability to create structure in evolving or ambiguous environments.
* Exceptional attention to detail and discretion when handling confidential company, financial, compensation, and employee information.
* Experience improving business processes through automation, systems implementation, or AI\-enabled workflows.
* Ability to work effectively with executives, functional leaders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a startup, high\-growth technology company, or global organization.
* Experience supporting CFO, CAO, COO, or Chief of Staff functions.
* Experience working across multiple corporate functions rather than within a single operational discipline.
* Experience implementing AI agents, workflow automation, internal knowledge systems, or operational dashboards.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bonsai Robotics**


Bonsai Robotics develops affordable, vision\-based autonomy that makes off\-road equipment smarter, safer, and more productive. We are redefining outdoor autonomy with Bonsai Intelligence, a connected platform that’s inspired by biology to see, think, and act with precision like a human. We bring together advanced perception, embodied AI, integrations with equipment manufacturers, and our compact, modular Amiga vehicles to deliver reliable automation to the world’s most demanding field operations \- reducing costs and increasing operational efficiencies. **About the role**


We are looking for a Senior Program Manager who can bring order to a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained organization — someone comfortable wearing multiple hats, working with lean teams, and helping us bring the proper program discipline needed to scale. You'll be the connective tissue across Product Management, Hardware Engineering, and Software Engineering — driving schedules, owning scope, managing budgets, managing dependencies, surfacing risk, and keeping leadership aligned on program status.

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the programs leader and primary link between cross functional product development teams; Product, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality.
* Own end\-to\-end program plans spanning product, hardware development (mechanical, electrical, manufacturing), and software development (firmware, controls, autonomy stack)
* Build and maintain integrated program charters, scopes, budgets and schedules, identifying cross\-team dependencies and critical path risks before they cause slip
* Run program cadences (stand\-ups, milestone reviews, leadership\-level status updates) across product and engineering disciplines
* Track budget, scope, and resourcing against plan; escalate tradeoffs to leadership with clear options
* Manage risk registers and drive mitigation plans for technical and schedule risk
* Coordinate with supply chain/procurement on hardware lead times and how they affect integration milestones
* Serve as the primary point of contact for program status to leadership stakeholders
* Help formalize program management processes and reporting as the company scales

**Qualifications**

* PMP certification
* 5\+ years program management experience in a hardware\-and\-software product environment (robotics, autonomous systems, industrial hardware, or similar)
* Demonstrated ability to manage schedules and dependencies across product management, mechanical/electrical, and software engineering teams
* Comfortable operating in a small, fast\-paced startup environment with limited process scaffolding — you'll be building some of it
* Strong command of program management tools (e.g., Jira, Gantt chart, etc.) and reporting to leadership stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication; skilled at aligning Product and Engineering stakeholders with different priorities and vocabularies
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience in both startup and larger/established company environments — able to bring scalable process rigor without over\-engineering for a small team
* Experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or embedded systems
* Familiarity with Agile and stage\-gate/NPI processes and how to reconcile them in one program

**Additional Details**

* This role is majority on\-site at our offices in San Jose and Watsonville, CA.
* Some travel may be required to support customers, partners, field deployments, and key company initiatives.

At Bonsai, we're building the future of robotics and we know that means investing in our people. We're committed to creating a workplace where you can do your best work, grow your skills, and feel genuinely part of something bigger.

 **Hybrid Flexibility (for selective roles)**


We operate on a hybrid model because we believe the best collaboration happens both in person and from where you work best. You'll have the flexibility to split your time between our office and home, so you can stay connected to the team while maintaining the balance that works for you.

 **Work\-life Balance**


The best employees are those who create balance in their lives, which is why we prioritize balance and well\-being for everyone at Bonsai. We foster a supportive environment where teammates look out for each other.

 **Covered Lunch**


On in\-office days, we've got lunch covered. It's a small thing that makes a big difference, with more time to connect with teammates and less to worry about.

 **Wellness and Benefits**


Your health matters. We offer comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), mental health support, and wellness programs designed to help you thrive both physically and mentally.

 **Collaborative Culture**


At Bonsai, you're not just part of a team, you're part of a community. We celebrate wins together, support each other through challenges, and genuinely enjoy the people we work with. From team events to cross\-functional collaboration, we're building something together.

 **Mission\-driven Work**


Every day, you're contributing to advancements in robotics that matter. If you're excited about innovation and impact, you'll find it here.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Project Management Office (PMO)
jobs.description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial\-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next\-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks.With our purified, high\-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.

We have built a state\-of\-the\-art, 100,000\-square\-foot manufacturing facility in Sacramento, CA (7910 Metro Air Pkwy) to ensure the consistent and reliable delivery of our high\-precision cell therapy products. This site is essential to advancing our clinical pipeline and supporting future commercial availability of our life\-saving therapies.  

The **Project Manager** is responsible for managing defined cross\-functional projects within the Project Management Office (PMO), with an emphasis on CMC implementation, Technical Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Clinical or Development\-related initiatives. This is a hands\-on project management role with ownership of project plans, timelines, deliverables, risks, and cross\-functional execution. The successful candidate will have direct experience driving projects in a biotechnology or pharmaceutical environment and will be comfortable working at the level of detail required to move complex, regulated work from plan through implementation. This individual must be able to translate project objectives, progress, risks, and decisions into clear project plans and concise communications for functional leaders and executives.


### **Physical Demands**

* *Production Associate Roles*: Must have visual acuity of 20/20 (corrected or uncorrected) and normal color vision to safely perform critical tasks such as visual inspection of materials, equipment, and labeling, including distinguishing color\-coded components in a GMP environment.
* *Most roles* must be able to meet cleanroom gowning requirements, including wearing full gowning (face coverings, gloves, hoods, goggles) for extended periods, as needed. Use of cosmetics (makeup, painted nails), jewelry, or facial piercings is not permitted in the cleanroom, and any skin conditions that cause shedding must be disclosed.

### **Work Conditions**

* *Many roles* must be able to work at either Orca Bio Sacramento location (3400 Business Dr. or 7910 Metro Air Pkwy) based on operational needs, as well as regularly participate in video\-based meetings. Also, may be required to work scheduled overtime, weekends, or holidays based on business needs.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage detailed cross\-functional project plans from initiation through implementation, including scope, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, decision points, and critical path activities.
* Manage defined CMC, Technical Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Clinical, and other business or operational projects, coordinating work across functional teams and maintaining accountability to agreed timelines and deliverables.
* Build, maintain, and drive project schedules in Smartsheet; ensure plans accurately reflect current status, dependencies, risks, and changes in execution.
* Identify schedule risks, resource or dependency constraints, and emerging blockers; work directly with project teams and functional leaders to develop mitigation plans, facilitate decisions, and escalate issues when appropriate.
* Lead project meetings and working sessions, establish clear agendas and objectives, document key decisions and actions, and ensure appropriate follow\-through across the project team.
* Develop clear project status reports, RAID logs, dashboards, milestone views, and executive\-level presentations that translate detailed project information into concise, decision\-oriented communications.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Technical Operations, Regulatory, Clinical, and Supply Chain stakeholders to support implementation activities in a regulated environment, including change controls, validation activities, operational readiness, and other project\-specific deliverables.
* Support PMO governance and portfolio management by providing accurate project data, communicating project health and priorities, and contributing to consistent project management practices across the organization.

### **Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of hands\-on project management or closely related experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, cell therapy, clinical, medical device, or other regulated life sciences industry. Candidates with fewer years may be considered when their experience demonstrates meaningful ownership of complex cross\-functional projects.
* Demonstrated experience directly managing CMC implementation, Technical Operations, pharmaceutical or cell therapy manufacturing, Quality, clinical operations, or comparable cross\-functional life sciences projects. Experience must include active ownership of project execution, not solely meeting coordination or administrative support.
* Demonstrated experience building and actively managing detailed project plans using Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, OnePlan, or a comparable scheduling tool. Smartsheet experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of FDA\-regulated environments and the project implications of GMP, GDP, quality systems, validation, change control, and operational or clinical implementation activities.

You will partner closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure localized products reach global users — contributing to Meta's mission to connect people across languages and cultures.  

  

  

### **Localization Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Own and drive localization programs across assigned product lines, identifying where existing workflows fall short and implementing AI\-powered improvements to increase scale and efficiency
* Navigate ambiguity in evolving product and AI landscapes — proactively identifying localization risks and unsolved problems, escalating effectively, and driving resolution across cross\-functional partners
* Leverage AI tools and automation as a force multiplier to redesign localization workflows, automating repetitive tasks and accelerating time\-to\-market across language markets
* Evaluate and prioritize localization work within your program areas by assessing business impact, aligning with cross\-functional partners on what to focus on, and ensuring resources are directed toward the highest\-value opportunities
* Build consensus and drive alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Content Design, Legal, Regional Growth) to drive product team adoption of standardized localization workflows, reducing ad\-hoc support and enabling the team to scale
* Communicate program status, risks, and recommendations clearly to cross\-functional partners and leadership, proactively surfacing tradeoffs and providing structured updates that enable informed decision\-making
* Coach and influence peers and partners on modern localization practices, building organizational capability by helping teams internalize how to build internationalization into their products and workflows from inception

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience in localization or equivalent program management, internationalization, or international product growth within a technology company
* Experience managing cross\-functional localization programs spanning multiple product lines, languages, and regional markets
* Experience operationalizing localization strategy, including vendor management, quality frameworks, and integration of localization into product development lifecycles
* Experience using data and metrics to inform program decisions and communicate priorities to stakeholders
* Experience navigating cross\-functional dependencies and driving alignment across product, engineering, and content teams
* Experience applying AI\-powered translation technologies or use of AI to improve efficiency and quality at scale

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting international product growth in emerging or high\-complexity language markets, including right\-to\-left languages or markets with significant linguistic variation
* Familiarity with internationalization engineering concepts such as Unicode handling, locale\-specific formatting, and string externalization that affect localization feasibility
