jobs.title: Remote Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and business minded Remote Operations Manager to own client relationships and design workflow for a growing luxury outdoor design firm. In this pivotal role, you will manage the full post\-sale client experience for outdoor contractors, pool builders, and general contractors — onboarding new clients, capturing design and revision requests, and routing work to our design team with speed and precision. Every client you speak with is a business owner running their own company, so a business\-minded approach and in field experience matter as much as design knowledge. You will hold real decision authority over scope, deadlines, and assignments, and you will build the systems this role runs on from the ground up. This is an exciting opportunity for a landscape professional who enjoys constant client contact, makes fast decisions, and wants to shape a position rather than inherit one.

**Duties**

* Own the client relationship for monthly member accounts.
* Onboard every new client following sale close, including the initial call, expectation setting, and orientation to our design process.
* Capture new design requests and revision requests through any channel the client prefers — email, phone, text, or video walkthrough — and document them in specific, actionable terms for the design team.
* Assign design and revision work to the senior lead designer or junior project manager the same business day, and set the corresponding deadline.
* Adjust deadlines and reallocate work between designers as capacity requires, in coordination with the senior lead designer.
* Conduct proactive check\-ins to identify client frustration before it becomes churn, and drive retention across the assigned account base.
* Convert trial clients into monthly members following completion of their trial designs, and re\-sign seasonally paused members each spring.
* Review completed designs for accuracy and buildability prior to client delivery, as capacity allows.
* Document the systems and processes of this role in written form sufficient for a future hire to follow.

**Required Skills**

* Hands\-on outdoor construction or design experience — field installation, design, or both. You will be discussing grading, drainage, hardscape, plant material, and what will actually build on site. Contractors can tell within minutes whether you have done this work.
* Business\-minded approach with the credibility to speak owner to owner. Our clients run contracting businesses, and they respond to someone who understands margin, job timelines, crew scheduling, and what wins them work.
* Fast, confident decision\-making under incomplete information, particularly on scope and prioritization. A request sitting unassigned overnight is a failure of this role.
* Exceptional attention to detail translating verbal client requests into written or drawn design direction. A misread note costs a designer a day and costs us a client's trust.
* Genuine enjoyment of high\-volume client contact with busy, direct professionals. This is the majority of the job, not an interruption to it.
* Strong verbal and written communication across phone, text, email, and video calls.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with reading or producing 3D renders and 2D construction plans.
* Ability to direct and coordinate work through colleagues who do not report to you.
* Comfort building processes, checklists, and documentation from scratch with no existing template.
* Proficiency with project management and CRM tools, or demonstrated ability to learn and configure them quickly.
* Prior account management, client success, or project management experience in a service business.

Join us as a Remote Operations Manager if you're ready to own client relationships end to end, make the calls that keep projects moving, and build the playbook the next person will follow.

Pay: $3,000\.00 \- $4,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

We also support our employees by offering generous benefits, such as flexible work, ample parental leave, and unlimited PTO. Click here to learn more about our benefits.


  
**About G2 \- The Company**  

  



G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.


Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M\+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.


And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.


Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!


**About G2 \- Our People**


At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (*P*erformance \+ *E*ntrepreneurship \+ *A*uthenticity \+ *K*indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value\-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.


You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals \- each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people\-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.


**About The Role**
------------------


G2 is seeking a hands on Marketing Operations Manager to own and scale the systems behind our marketing to sales pipeline. This role owns critical revenue operations infrastructure, including lead lifecycle architecture, MQA routing and disposition, contact and account enrichment, and the scoring and prioritization frameworks that directly shape pipeline quality and sales efficiency.


This role connects Marketing, Sales, and Business Systems, acting as the operational owner responsible for clean lead flow, accurate data, fast speed to lead, and a GTM stack that supports business goals.


The ideal candidate pairs deep technical fluency across our MarTech stack (Salesforce, Clay, Marketo, Qualified, Ringlead) with strong analytical judgment and the ability to move fast and stay precise in a B2B SaaS environment.


**In This Role, You Will Be Responsible For:**
----------------------------------------------


***Lead Management \& Routing***


* Own and optimize lead, contact, and account lifecycle processes across Salesforce, including MQL/SAL/SQL disposition logic, and auto\-recycle timing
* Support GTM scalability through automation, governance, and process standardization initiatives
* Maintain and optimize lead to account matching, deduplication, and enrichment workflows
* Support account segmentation and routing strategy informed by 6sense, Factors.ai, or other intent signals

jobs.description:
**About Omnidian**
Omnidian, Inc. is a fast\-growing Series C tech\-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. *We are a certified B Corps, headquartered in Seattle, WA* **The Job**

The Commercial Portfolio Operations Manager oversees a portfolio of assigned distributed generation solar assets and energy storage projects, ensuring optimal performance for their clients. Reporting to the Manager of Commercial Operations, this role works closely with the entire Commercial Operations Team. As the primary point of contact for their clients, the qualified candidate will work cross\-functionally to manage the full asset lifecycle: onboarding new clients and assets, delivering on reporting obligations, coordinating technical support and service technicians, and supporting sales and product development initiatives.
### **What You’ll Do**


* Own client relationships for a portfolio of 100–200 MW of distributed solar assets post\-PTO, advising on preventive and corrective maintenance.
* Report on monthly asset performance, providing both executive summaries and deeper technical explanation as needed.
* Convert DAS provided technical performance into a business narrative: lost production into lost revenue, downtime into guarantee or incentive risk, proposed maintenance into cost avoidance, increased availability into increased revenue.
* Anticipate client and portfolio needs, manage expectations proactively, and preserve the relationship through service failures.
* Treat client retention, renewal, and portfolio health as cross functionally owned outcomes.
* Deliver service reports and support technicians on site completing work in the field
* Create and manage Salesforce Cases and Work Orders for planned and unplanned service activities
* Serve as the technical point of contact between the client, Performance Management, Field Operations and Technical Operations
* Track open technical escalations across a portfolio, ensuring Performance Management and Technical Operations findings translate into timely client communication and follow\-through.
* Determine when an issue requires escalation to Performance Management or Technical Operations versus what can be resolved through standard field service dispatch. Flag systemic or recurring issues observed across a portfolio to Performance Management for fleet\-level trend analysis
* Maintain working knowledge of common failure modes and DAS alarm patterns sufficient to have an informed technical conversation with clients and internal specialist teams

* Solid technical understanding of business operations and a knack for quickly learning new tools (CRM, support ticketing, ERP, BI)

* Thrives in a fast\-paced, growth\-mode environment; adapts quickly and stays composed under pressure
* Eager to keep learning and expanding your skill set

* 1\+ years of experience in Commercial operations and maintenance, asset management, field service management, or account management.
* 2\+ years of experience in the solar energy industry
* 3\+ years of professional experience with proven professional acumen
* Proven experience with client success and customer service
* Experience with solar monitoring DAS platforms and alerts.
* Experience reading and interpreting solar system design drawings.
* Understanding of solar technology, monitoring systems, maintenance practices, and solar industry landscape.
### **Experience That's a Plus**


* 3\+ years of solar experience
* 2\+ years of Commercial post installation experience

* Experience in event project management, field marketing, experiential marketing, or a similar cross\-functional role.
* Experience managing multiple events simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment with competing priorities and evolving requirements.

Are you ready to join an innovative company with over 100 years of excellence and a steadfast commitment to ethical business practices? Amentum is hiring a Microelectronics Program Manager to support our U.S. government customers.


This role offers a unique opportunity to leverage your expertise in the microelectronics and semiconductor industry to address critical challenges in global supply chain risk analysis. As the Program Manager, you will lead a small, specialized team to track and analyze trends, conduct in\-depth technology assessments, respond to customer inquiries, and identify systemic vulnerabilities within the global microelectronics landscape.


While this position does not involve managing supply chain logistics or operations, a strong understanding of semiconductor industry ecosystems, technical processes, and supply chain complexities is required.

**This is a remote role with the flexibility of working from home; however, candidates must live within a reasonable driving distance of the Boston, MA area to accommodate occasional site visits on short notice.**

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**:

* Represent Amentum’s microelectronics team with government clients and implement scalable research strategies addressing global semiconductor risks.
* Lead and support the production, review, and refinement of the team’s responses to government Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of semiconductor hardware, processes, and supply chains—from intellectual property to end\-user delivery—identifying vulnerabilities and risk elements.
* Research and analyze publicly available data, including strategic planning, demand/capacity forecasts, regulatory considerations, safety and risk factors, and performance trends.
* Provide actionable recommendations and insights to mitigate supply chain risks and help government clients make informed decisions.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement in gathering open\-source microelectronics data and creating risk assessments.
* Manage a small team to deliver high\-quality, complex risk analysis deliverables.
* Provide on\-site client support as needed for inquiries, ad\-hoc reporting, and guidance on analytical methods.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* An active Secret U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is required to maintain this clearance).
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 10\+ years of experience in program management/support or supply chain risk analysis.
* At least 4 years of professional experience in the microelectronics/semiconductor industry.
* Proven ability to conduct detailed research and produce insightful analytical reports.
* Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities.
* Proficient in business tools like Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of n\-tier supply chain risk analysis across the semiconductor ecosystem.
* Ability to lead effectively in ambiguous situations and adapt to evolving priorities.

**Overview**  
**Bull Bear Defense Solutions** is seeking an experienced Project Manager / Scrum Master to lead Agile delivery, operational excellence, and strategic alignment for a high\-impact modernization effort supporting the U.S. Department of the Interior, Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA). The program spans the implementation, integration, and ongoing sustainment of the eNativeTrust platform and the next\-generation Electronic Probate System (EPS), delivered within a secure Microsoft Azure Government (FedRAMP Moderate) cloud environment to improve services for American Indian and Alaska Native communities nationwide.

You will lead cross\-functional Agile teams delivering cloud services, mobile applications, data transformation pipelines, and automated workflows using modern Microsoft technologies and DevSecOps practices, while serving as a primary liaison between the project team, client stakeholders, and agency leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Agile Leadership \& Scrum Facilitation**

· Lead and facilitate all Agile ceremonies — daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — tracking sprint velocity, burndown, and CI/CD pipeline health using Azure DevOps.

· Coach teams on Agile, SDLC, DevOps, and continuous integration practices.

· Maintain a well\-prioritized, technically sound product backlog aligned with mission needs.

· Remove blockers impacting development flow, deployment readiness, or operational stability.

**Project Management \& Delivery Oversight**

· Manage implementation and sustainment projects for eNativeTrust and EPS using Agile and DevSecOps approaches.

· Develop project schedules, dependency maps, risk registers, and release strategies.

· Coordinate cross\-functional groups spanning software, mobile, data engineering, operations, security, cloud engineering, and QA.

· Work closely with government stakeholders across BIA, OHA, LTRO, and BTFA to align technical delivery with mission needs.

· Support on\-site discovery and validation sessions, including travel to field offices (e.g., Albuquerque, Anchorage, Anadarko, Aberdeen) to gather insights directly from those who serve Native communities.

· Ensure project scope, schedule, and quality expectations are met.

· Prepare and deliver briefings, dashboards, and transparent status updates — velocity, burndown, KPIs — to client executives, agency leadership, and governance bodies.

**Operations Management \& System Sustainment**

· Oversee daily operations of eNativeTrust and EPS, including monitoring, incident response, problem management, and release coordination.

· Manage operational workflows, SOPs, runbooks, and system maintenance using DevOps and CI/CD best practices.

· Partner with development teams to ensure stable deployments, reliable system performance, and rapid issue resolution.

· Support cloud environment maintenance, configuration management, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices.

· Drive continuous improvement across system performance, user experience, and operational efficiency.

**Compliance \& Stakeholder Engagement**

· Ensure compliance with federal cybersecurity, privacy, records, and accessibility requirements (NIST 800\-53, FedRAMP, ATO processes, Section 508, Privacy Act, tribal consultation requirements).

· Engage diverse stakeholders, from Tribal leaders to federal executives, translating complex requirements into actionable solutions.

Provide clear, proactive communication and transparent reporting to leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

Demonstrated experience as a Scrum Master, Project Manager, Operations Manager, or hybrid role in enterprise IT environments, ideally within federal programs.

· Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps principles, and automated testing.

· Azure DevOps mastery: hands\-on experience with Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans, and Wiki; proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, and Git.

· FedRAMP fluency: understanding of NIST 800\-53, ATO processes, and continuous monitoring.

· Cloud architecture knowledge: Azure services, microservices, and API design.

· Metrics expertise: able to translate team velocity and CI/CD pipeline health into executive dashboards.

· Proven ability to coordinate between management, technical teams, and stakeholders, and to communicate with both technical and non\-technical audiences.

· Experience supporting enterprise system implementation, modernization, or sustainment.

· Ability to obtain and maintain a federal background check.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Scrum Master certifications (CSM, PSM, SAFe).

· PMP, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent project management certification.

· Experience in federal IT environments, digital identity systems, trust services, or workflow automation.

· Knowledge of cloud architectures, DevSecOps practices, automated compliance, and infrastructure\-as\-code.

**Core Competencies**

* Agile leadership and facilitation
* SDLC and software engineering fluency
* CI/CD pipeline management
* DevOps collaboration and automation
* Executive\-level communication and stakeholder engagement
* Operational excellence and IT service management
* Risk identification, mitigation, and strategic planning
* Continuous improvement and analytical problem\-solving
* Direct interface with client stakeholders and agency leadership

Remote

jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission\-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high\-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

 **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

 **Position Title:** Program Manager of Projects

**Position Location:** Remote \- work from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major airport.

**Travel Requirements:** Up to 50% domestic travel. Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.

 **JOB SUMMARY**


The Program Manager of Projects (PgM\-Projects) is responsible for execution quality, financial performance, and Project Manager development across multiple concurrent commissioning projects. This role is the primary driver of project delivery within the Field Services Group, converting program\-level direction into consistent, predictable outcomes at the site level while providing the financial monitoring and demand\-side labor forecasting that informs portfolio\-level decisions.

  

The Program Manager of Projects partners directly with the PgM\-People and PgM\-Technical verticals and reports to the Associate Director, ensuring the AD receives accurate delivery and financial reporting without being drawn into project\-level execution.

  

The Program Manager of Projects will convert tactical planning to tactical deployment / coordination to meet strategic objectives.

  

The Program Manager of Projects will be self\-directed on day\-to\-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute commissioning and lead project teams and projects of complex scope. Will coordinate activities of other personnel.

  

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Project Execution \& PM Leadership (40%)**

* Oversee execution performance across all active commissioning projects and sites, ensuring scope is delivered consistently, on time, and to DLB quality standards.
* Directly manage, mentor, and develop Project Managers; elevate capability in planning discipline, risk identification, client communication, and financial management.
* Conduct weekly project execution reviews with each PM, covering schedule status, manpower forecast, risks, action items, and deliverables.
* Serve as the first escalation point for project\-level execution issues; resolve at the PgM level before escalating to the AD.
* Validate PM project plans, schedules, and sequencing; identify and correct execution drift early.
* Maintain accountability for PM performance standards and prepare PMs for increasing project complexity over time.

 **Financial Monitoring \& Reporting (25%)**

* Own weekly and monthly financial monitoring across the project portfolio.
* Conduct monthly detailed financial reviews with each PM covering labor, expenses, invoicing status, and projected billing.
* Report to the AD on any projects not meeting profitability targets, including root cause assessment and defined corrective action plans.
* Identify early indicators of budget risk, burn rate anomalies, or emerging change\-order drivers and escalate with recommended mitigation.
* Ensure PMs maintain accurate, current financial records and that backlog, SOV, and VantagePoint data are updated as part of the monthly invoicing cycle.

 **Demand\-Side Labor Forecasting \& AD Coordination (15%)**

* Consolidate project manpower forecasts into a program\-level demand signal.
* Coordinate monthly with PgM\-People to compare the demand signal against the workforce supply signal; identify resourcing gaps or capacity surpluses.

* Provide the AD with a high\-level weekly portfolio summary covering budget, schedule, manpower, and client relationship health across active projects.

* Identify and surface follow\-on work opportunities during client and site engagement.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, GTM Launch
jobs.description:
**About Dutchie**



Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40\+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.



Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

#### **About This Job**



The Senior Project Manager, GTM Launch owns the launch management system that gets Dutchie’s feature and product launches from ready\-to\-launch through adoption and measurable impact across our full product suite. This is a senior, autonomous role within Revenue Operations, acting as the connective tissue across Product, Engineering, Enablement, Marketing, Support, go\-to\-market teams, and most importantly, our customers.



You will lead complex launches with minimal oversight, proactively surface risk before it becomes an escalation, and own change management for both internal teams and customers. You’ll be equally comfortable driving a cross\-functional operating cadence, influencing senior stakeholders when scope or timing is at risk, and pulling adoption data yourself to measure success and impact.



Success is not simply shipping on time; it is ensuring teams are ready, customers understand the value, adoption follows, and each launch makes the next one better.


#### **What You'll Do…**


* Own end\-to\-end project management for assigned feature and product launches — scoping, sequencing, timelines, dependencies, go/no\-go criteria, and post\-launch follow\-through — in partnership with Product and Engineering leads.
* Maintain the launch board as the single source of truth, ensuring active launches have clear status, ownership, dependencies, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Establish and run efficient, action\-oriented launch cadences that keep cross\-functional teams aligned, surface decisions early, and drive clear accountability.
* Design and run internal change management for each launch, including readiness plans for Sales, CSM, Support, Implementation, Marketing, and Enablement, with clear ownership of what must be true before GA.
* Design and run customer\-facing change management, including rollout sequencing, customer communications, pilot or cohort strategy, and coordination with Marketing and Support.
* Proactively identify blocked or at\-risk work, clarify tradeoffs, and coordinate solutions before stakeholders have to escalate.
* Translate changes in scope, timing, or dependencies into clear downstream business and customer impact, and drive the right stakeholders toward decisions.
* Develop working product knowledge deep enough to answer audience, functionality, and semi\-technical questions on each launch without unnecessary escalation, connecting feature\-level detail to customer and business impact.
* Partner closely with Technical Writing and Enablement, validating that release notes, training materials, internal guidance, and customer communications accurately reflect product functionality and positioning.
* Define success metrics before launch across internal readiness and external outcomes such as adoption, activation, usage, customer sentiment, and support volume.
* Monitor post\-launch performance and proactively engage pilot, alpha, or early\-adopter customers to identify friction, validate value, and surface emerging risks.
* Build feedback loops that turn launch data and customer signals into action — flagging underperformance quickly and driving retrospectives that result in clear owners and follow\-through.
* Continuously improve the launch operating system by identifying high\-leverage process, tooling, or automation opportunities and driving stakeholder alignment through implementation.
* Use AI and the broader tool suite to accelerate research, synthesize launch signals, improve documentation and reporting, identify risk patterns, and reduce manual work — while applying judgment and validating outputs.

#### **What You Bring**


* 5\+ years of project or program management experience, with meaningful ownership of feature or product launches in a SaaS or technology GTM environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of change management for both internal teams and external customers, including readiness, communications, rollout strategy, and adoption.
* Strong analytical orientation: able to define launch success metrics, pull and interpret product or usage data, and translate findings into action.
* Proven track record of proactive communication and risk management — surfaces issues early, frames tradeoffs clearly, and drives toward resolution.
* Strong facilitation and operating\-rhythm skills: keeps cross\-functional groups focused, drives decisions, and creates clear accountability without relying on formal authority.
* Demonstrated curiosity and follow\-through: builds enough product and domain expertise to represent launches credibly with stakeholders and customers, and validates rather than assumes.
* Experience improving cross\-functional processes, systems, or tooling and driving those changes through adoption.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence senior stakeholders, hold a line on scope or timeline with empathy, and adapt communication for technical, GTM, and customer audiences.

#### **It’s a Bonus if You…**

jobs.title: ASL Interpreter Success & Onboarding Coordinator (Interpreter Concierge)
jobs.description:
About ASL Communication

ASL Communication is an ASL interpreting agency. Sign language interpreting is the core of what we do and what we're known for, and we also provide spoken\-language interpreting, CART, and captioning across Nevada, Utah, and Colorado. We've been doing this since 2006, serving school districts, hospital systems, courts, universities, and government agencies.

We're a small team that treats interpreters as our most important customer, not just contractors we hire. Our reputation is built on filling assignments other agencies won't and doing right by the deaf, deaf\-blind, and limited\-English\-proficiency communities we serve. We're growing, and this role is central to how we grow well.

**About the role**

Our ability to fill interpreting assignments depends on one thing: having interpreters who are fully onboarded, properly credentialed and badged, accurately set up in our systems, and ready and willing to accept work. This role is responsible for making that happen.

As our Interpreter Concierge, you own each interpreter from the moment they're recruited to the moment they're ready to work, and you keep them ready after that. You're the connection between recruiting and scheduling, and you directly protect the near\-99% fill rate our clients count on.

This role rewards consistency and follow\-through, not adrenaline. If you love taking a proven process and running it cleanly every time, keeping dozens of details from slipping, and building real relationships with the people you support, you'll do well here.

**What you'll do**

**Support interpreter success.** From the moment an interpreter says yes to working with us, through their first assignment and beyond, you're their main point of contact. You make sure they're properly onboarded, set up correctly in our system, and ready to start seeing and accepting assignments.

**Own the onboarding pipeline.** Run our proprietary onboarding sequence ("Path to Partnership") and interpreter project boards. Move every new interpreter from recruited to documents complete to credentialed to badged to ready\-to\-work, with nothing stalling in between.

**Manage credentialing and badging.** Track RID certification and CEUs, state interpreter registry status, and the badge and tier requirements across our eight interpreting work categories. Assemble each interpreter's file so it's complete and decision\-ready. Run a standing audit of who's been badged and who hasn't, and work the gap list until it closes.

**Keep our systems accurate.** Own the accuracy of every interpreter's profile in our operations software: correct group placement, current availability, up\-to\-date credentials and work categories, and clear notes on badges and preferences that a scheduler can scan and act on. This data sits directly beneath our fill rate, so precision matters.

**Keep interpreters ready and equipped.** Flag lapsing credentials before they expire, nudge renewals, and keep availability current. Make sure active interpreters have what they need in hand, including business cards and feedback cards, and restock ahead of busy periods.

**Absorb the surges.** Onboard interpreters in batches through the same repeatable process during back\-to\-school and conference seasons, so growth never turns into a scramble.

**Communicate and support.** Own our recurring interpreter newsletter (credential deadlines, process changes, upcoming work, and recognition), and be the first point of contact helping interpreters get set up and navigate our self\-service portal. Support the interpreter workshops ASL Communication sponsors, and work with our leadership team and interpreter advisory committee to make sure projects that help interpreters actually get executed.

You'll partner closely with our scheduling and technology teams, who own matching interpreters to assignments and maintaining the software itself. Your lane is getting interpreters in the door, ready, and accurately represented in our systems.

**What we're looking for**

* You finish what you start. You're organized and systematic, and you keep a lot of moving pieces on track without being reminded.
* You're precise with data and documentation. Accuracy is a point of pride, not a chore.
* You're steady and dependable, and you genuinely like people. You build trust and rapport easily, and you're patient with the folks you support.
* You're comfortable living in software all day: CRMs, spreadsheets, project boards (we use Monday.com), and internal platforms you'll learn.
* You write clearly and warmly. A good chunk of this job is written communication with interpreters.
* You'd rather run a clean, repeatable system than improvise through chaos.

**Nice to have (not required):**

* Experience in language access, interpreting, or the ASL and deaf community
* Familiarity with RID certification, CEUs, or state interpreter and CART registries
* Experience in credentialing, provider enrollment, onboarding, or HR coordination
* Experience supporting 1099 contractors or freelancers
* Some ASL knowledge, or a willingness to learn, is welcomed. This is a coordination role, not an interpreting one.

Location, schedule, and pay

* **Location:** Fully remote. You can live anywhere, but you'll need to be available to work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific or Mountain time, which are our core business hours.
* **Schedule:** Full\-time.
* **Pay:** $25 per hour.
* **Benefits:** Vision, dental, a 401(k) plan, short\-term and long\-term disability, and paid time off (PTO).

**Why this role matters**

Every assignment we fill is someone getting access in a moment that matters: a medical appointment, a courtroom, a child's classroom. You'll be the reason interpreters are ready when those requests come in. It's operational work with a real human purpose behind it.

jobs.title: Bilingual Patient Care Navigator
jobs.description:
**Advance your career into a future\-focused telehealth position!** **Great opportunity to work from home!**


We are looking for **Bilingual** Patient Care Navigators to work full\-time (40 hours per week). The current schedule needs are in the day/evening, eight or ten hour shifts between the hours of 8a\-7p, with an alternating weekend requirement. If you are tech\-savvy, have excellent verbal/phone skill, are proficient in both English and Spanish, and have a strong work ethic, consider joining this team!


As a Patient Care Navigator, you will be responsible for processing calls and generating reports from Medcor Telehealth Triage clients, supervisors, or injured workers in situations where triage is not required, within our remote call center environment. During this process, you will be required to follow standard operating procedures to place calls in the correct company and location, gather \& document basic demographic information about the workplace incident, and provide information to the injured worker or supervisor as requested by Medcor’s client.  

  

**Here’s why people love working for Medcor:**


* Stability! We’ve been around since 1984\.
* Competitive pay and benefits.
* Training to give you the tools you need to succeed.
* Future opportunities – Medcor is a growing company with a lot more to offer than just this job. There are opportunities to move vertically, horizontally, and geographically!
* Open\-door policy. Your opinion matters – speak your mind! We encourage it and we look forward working together to improve our organization and your job.


**A typical day in the life of a Patient Care Navigator**


* Answer inbound employee and/or supervisor injury report calls where triage is not required, within a fast\-paced remote call center environment. Immediately transfer calls requiring triage to the appropriate triage queue.
* Follow standard operating procedure and client specific directives in order to correctly gather pertinent information from injured workers or supervisor and enter into proprietary software to complete the call report.
* Enter information into Medcor’s Triage software application that accurately reflects the phone interaction of each inbound/outbound triage call associated to one of Medcor’s Client’s, either supervisor, injured employee, or medical providers.


* Ability to follow protocols, including Medcor’s proprietary algorithms and completing forms/fields in the application.
* Use professional phone etiquette \& excellent customer service skills during phone interactions to help ensure client satisfaction \& retention. Effectively assist the caller with problem solving all issues related to their call.
* Promote clear and coherent verbal communication with callers following an appropriate line of questioning and clarification of information when needed.
* Read \& apply all client specific directives as they appear throughout the call process, gathering or providing information to injured worker and/or supervisor as directed.


* Responsible for collecting and inputting data elements that will support the documentation and reports
* Follow HIPAA Compliance Policies to protect the confidentiality of information.


* Responsible for personal schedule adherence and accurately reflecting all shift activities using the phone system.


* Monitor your own performance with dashboard metrics, reviewing \& acknowledging individual stats, and look for ways to improve. Participate in coaching sessions to improve performance.


* Compliance with all departmental standards, policies, and procedures as they relate to call processing, attendance, adherence, and quality standards.


* Responsible for timely completion of annual or monthly assignments in MedcorU, such as Compliance Modules, Training Bulletins, and Staff meeting newsletters.


* Responsible for projects and duties delegated by the Operations Manager or Director.


* Always supports Medcor’s Core Values \& Culture.


* Attend meetings at the request of the leadership or Learning and Development teams.


**You Must:**


* Have a high school diploma or GED.
* Be fluent in both English and Spanish.
* At least two years of customer service or client relations experience is preferred.
* A basic understanding of occupational job processes and potential injuries as it relates to various industries is also helpful.
* Proficient at data entry, speed and accuracy; that is able to enter information while listening \& engaging in conversation with caller. Must be able to type at least 25 words per minute.
* PC proficiency is required, with experience in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and Outlook
* Ability to maintain high\-speed, hard\-wired, internet connection at advocate residence that meets the specifications as outlined by Medcor’s IT department and allows for processing of triage calls with quality.

**The most competitive** **candidates** **will...**
* Have a working knowledge or background in any medical field (strongly preferred, but not required).
* Be comfortable working in a call center environment, with minimal oversight or direct interaction with coworkers.
* Possess excellent verbal/written communication skills.


**???????****Medcor Benefits**


Paid time off, health and dental insurance, 401K with match, education reimbursement and more. Supportive environment. *To learn more about Medcor’s Culture click* *here*.  

  

**Medcor Philosophy**  

Medcor embraces a set of simple, interconnected practices that everyone can tailor to their own life and work. To preserve our pioneering, entrepreneurial spirit, we impart our values through the ongoing Better@Medcor campaign: encouraging our advocates to make a conscious choice to practice our values, to celebrate and recognize each other via our peer recognition program, and to support one another during tough times.  

  

Medcor is a tobacco free and smoke free workplace!  

  

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

jobs.title: Customer Experience Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**
Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose\-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.


When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry. **Vision Statement**
Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime. **Mission Statement**
Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers. **Core Values*** We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.
  

Right now, when a customer has a problem, three different teams each have their own version of what's happening and their own list of what Product should fix next. Nobody is lying, they're just each holding a different piece of the same picture. We need someone who can hold the whole picture.


As Assembly's **Customer Experience Program Manager,** you'll sit at the center of Customer Success, Customer Support, and Professional Services without running any of them. When an escalation needs to move, you're the one who makes sure it actually does. When Support, Success, and Professional Services each show up to Product with a different list of what matters most, you're the one who turns three lists into one that Product can actually act on. You'll run the CSAT and NPS program end to end, keep implementation and training logistics running on schedule, and own the systems that make all of this visible.


This isn't a role where you manage people to get things done. It's a role where you build enough trust and clarity across three teams that they move together without needing to be told to. If you're the kind of person who already can't stand watching good teams talk past each other, this is built for you.


If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

 **When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:** **1\. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  

Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

 **2\. What makes Assembly Software different?**  

Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

 **3\. What's the benefits package like?**  

Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program


We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

 *Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Global Technical Documentation Control Program Manager
jobs.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750\+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award\-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.  

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting\-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.  

  

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.  


We are seeking a Global Technical Documentation Control Program Manager who thinks in terms of scalable, interconnected systems. This strategic technical leader will establish and oversee a technical document control and governance framework spanning the entire lifecycle of our data center portfolio—from initial technical design and construction to L0–L6 commissioning, and long\-term operational management. The successful candidate will also ensure this program aligns with corporate policies governing document and information management and retention schedules.



As the owner of our technical documentation program, you will bridge the gap between design engineering standards and operational reality. You will ensure that records for vital engineering assets—including electrical diagrams, control network schematics, Bill of Materials (BOMs), telemetry schemas, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs/MOPs)—are meticulously verified, version\-controlled, and unified across our expanding global fleet.



### **Key Accountabilities**



1\. Design Stage Standards \& Governance



* Establish Document Control Governance: Architect, implement, and maintain a standardized global document control and governance framework defining how engineering specifications, technical drawings, and standard operational procedures are created, approved, versioned, and distributed.
* Design Standards Feedback Loop: Oversee the structural process for capturing feedback during competitive bidding and Request for Information (RFI) periods. Analyze, compile, and prioritize shortcomings identified in project specs to systematically update and release future versions of our Master Design Standards.
* Design Collaboration: Partner with internal design engineering teams and external design firms to influence design\-for\-serviceability and ensure standardized templates and procedures are baked into all project scopes of work (SOWs).
2\. Commissioning \& Construction Handoff (L0–L6\)



* Milestone Quality Assurance: Direct documentation tracking and quality assurance across all construction and L1–L5 commissioning phases, validating that testing and documents are verified, complete, accurate and under revision control before handover.
* Ready For Service (RFS): Enforce strict handover criteria at the final Ready For Service (RFS) milestone, ensuring zero documentation gaps exist at the point of handoff to local operations and customer support teams.
* As\-Built Document Auditing: Act as the final gatekeeper for "As\-Built" packages at the conclusion of L5 testing and as part of L6 closeouts.. Review and archive finalized vendor submittals, control schematics, asset inventories, global telemetry/MQTT topic maps, and client required documentation to ensure 100% completeness.
3\. Lifecycle Management \& Operations Alignment



* Standardized Operational Procedures (SOPs/MOPs): Partner with Operations leaders and Technical Writers to develop highly precise, repeatable SOPs, MOPs, and safety standards for critical facility systems (including mechanical plants, UPS lineups, and industrial HVAC) that balance global standardization with localized site variables.
* Asset Management Integration: Manage the central documentation library within SharePoint, integrating files directly with our InCommand platform to ensure physical hardware configurations match their digital "Source of Truth."
* Maintenance \& Obsolescence Databases: Support the Controls and Instrumentation teams by establishing tracking systems for sensor calibration certificates, equipment Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), and obsolescence planning databases.
### **Required Skills**



* Experience: 3\+ years of direct experience in documentation control, program management, or technical writing within critical infrastructure environments (e.g., data centers, defense, pharmaceutical, utilities, or heavy manufacturing).
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a closely aligned Engineering discipline, Construction Management, or equivalent industry/military experience.
* Systems \& Software: Demonstrated mastery of Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), SharePoint, and standard productivity tools (Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Visio).
* Engineering Literacy: Robust capability to read, interpret, and organize engineering drawings, electrical single\-lines, control network schematics, and equipment Bill of Materials (BOM).
* Analytical Execution: A detail\-oriented mindset with a commitment to accuracy, performing gap analyses on technical documentation, identifying process inefficiencies, and implementing structural improvements.
### **Preferred Qualifications**



* Global Standardization: Proven track record of developing "Nationwide" or "Global" umbrella models for technical documentation and standards maintenance.
* Controls Exposure: Familiarity with Building Management Systems (BMS), Electric

jobs.description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.

OpenText is seeking a Senior Cloud Business Analyst to join our Managed Cloud Services team. WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS
  
  

* Partner with our COE Software Engineers and their leadership to complete required Managed Services Integration project activity deliverables
* Review and approve client requirements and design documentation with Sr Software Engineers, Architects, Solution Consultant and Project Managers.
* Interface with Solution Consultants and Global Architecture to transition new Sales activity into Deliverable solutions with confirmed project schedules


YOU ARE GREAT AT
  
* Consult, Review and Approve SDD documents and Readiness Review artifacts

You'll own a portfolio of law firm accounts from the moment onboarding ends, running the proactive outreach, health reviews, and training that keep clients engaged and adopting new features. And when you spot the kind of expansion or referral signal that only comes from a trusted relationship, you'll route it to the right team as a real, qualified lead, not just a note in passing.


If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy\-to\-use platform and industry\-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

  

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love \- Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

 **We Are Looking for a Customer Success Manager Who Thinks Strategically, Communicates Exceptionally, and Puts Customers First**


We are seeking a sharp, driven, and deeply customer\-focused professional with experience in CPG trade management to join our Customer Success team. This is not a support role. It is a strategic partnership role. You will own the outcomes of the accounts you manage, proactively guiding customers toward measurable business value and deeper adoption of the Vividly platform.

  

If you are a self\-starter who leads with curiosity, communicates with clarity and confidence, and knows how to turn data into insights and insights into action, you will thrive here. We need someone who has lived on the front lines of Small to Midsize Business (SMB) Trade, someone who understands the complexity of trade spend and can translate that expertise into transformational customer partnerships.

**Key Responsibilities and Impact**
-----------------------------------

* **Lead with strategy, not just service**. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers by acting as a proactive strategic advisor, not a reactive problem\-solver. Guide customers toward their goals before they know they need guidance.
* **Apply critical thinking to every account.** Analyze customer usage patterns, platform data, and business context to identify adoption gaps, risks, and growth opportunities. Translate what you see into clear recommendations and action plans that drive measurable outcomes.
* **Communicate with precision and purpose**. Own every customer interaction, written, verbal, and in\-meeting, with the clarity and confidence of someone who respects the customer's time and leads conversations with intention. This means clear agendas, concise follow\-ups, and proactive outreach that adds value before customers ask for it.
* **Champion the customer's success internally.** Serve as the voice of your customers across product, sales, and marketing. Surface feedback, patterns, and risks with the evidence to back them up. Advocate for improvements that create better outcomes across the entire customer base.
* **Drive platform adoption and user expansion.** Don't just onboard; embed. Identify underutilized features, low\-adoption users, and untapped teams within your accounts. Design enablement strategies that scale beyond one\-on\-one training and create organizational dependency on the Vividly platform.
* **Multi\-thread your accounts.** Build relationships across each organization, not just with your primary contact. Identify champions, executive sponsors, power users, and operational stakeholders. Proactively protect against single points of failure.
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally with structure.** Partner with specialists, product, and sales teams to build repeatable, well\-documented customer success playbooks. Every customer should have a clear success plan, defined milestones, and documented outcomes.
* **Represent Vividly as a TPM thought leader.** Help shape the industry conversation. We want CSMs who can contribute to best practices, case studies, and community conversations that position Vividly as the definitive platform for SMB CPG trade management.
* **Set boundaries that protect your strategic value.** Redirect technical support and break\-fix issues to the appropriate Support channels. Your role is to own strategy, adoption, and outcomes, not to be a one\-person help desk.

**You Will Be Successful With**
-------------------------------

* 5\+ years of experience in Trade Promotion Management \- you understand the complexity of trade spend and can speak the customer's language from day one
* CPG industry experience is strongly recommended \- deductions, accruals, and general trade finance experience strongly preferred; POS data and TPM software experience are a significant plus
* Strong critical thinking skills \- you can analyze ambiguous situations, connect disparate signals, and develop clear, evidence\-based recommendations without being told what to look for
* An authentically customer\-first mindset \- you measure your success by your customers' outcomes, not your task completion rate; you anticipate needs, not just respond to them
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills \- you write follow\-up emails that customers actually read, you run meetings that end with clarity, and you can tailor your message to an operations manager and a C\-suite executive in the same week
* Proactive account leadership \- you don't wait for customers to come to you; you show up with insights, recommendations, and a point of view
* Technical aptitude with SaaS platforms \- you are comfortable navigating and explaining complex software and can help customers get the most out of the tools they have
* Comfort with ambiguity and change \- you

jobs.description:
As a Lead Customer Success Manager focused on State, Local, and Education (SLED) customers, you'll own a portfolio of government and higher education accounts and serve as the advisor they rely on to connect Workiva's platform to the outcomes that matter most in their sector. You understand the distinct rhythms of public sector organizations: budget cycles tied to fiscal years, procurement constraints, multi\-agency stakeholder maps, and a mission focus that shapes every conversation. You'll operate in partnership with the account executive across your full book, driving retention, adoption, and growth with the discipline and domain fluency this market demands.


**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Customer Journey \& Success Planning**
----------------------------------------

* Build and maintain a clear picture of each account's organizational structure, budget cycle, procurement process, and strategic priorities, then develop account plans that connect those realities to Workiva capabilities
* Cultivate relationships across multiple stakeholder layers including department heads, finance officers, IT leaders, and elected or appointed officials, as an ongoing partnership rather than a contract\-driven engagement
* Identify platform growth opportunities by mapping Workiva capabilities against SLED\-specific requirements, including grant tracking and transparency initiatives
* Lead Business Reviews that speak to public sector outcomes: audit readiness, compliance efficiency, reporting accuracy, and resource stewardship rather than generic ROI metrics

**Platform Adoption**
---------------------

* Use Product Usage data and health signals to diagnose what's working and what isn't, then design targeted interventions that account for the change management constraints common in government environments
* Ask consultative questions to uncover workflow gaps and build enablement plans align with SLED procurement and training norms, driving lasting behavior change rather than short\-term usage spikes

**Sales Collaboration**
-----------------------

* Identify expansion opportunities through structured whitespace analysis, including cross\-department and cross\-agency growth potential, and bring well\-qualified signals to your AE with a clear public sector business case
* Provide renewal forecasts well ahead of deadlines, accounting for the longer approval timelines typical in government accounts, flag risk early with a mitigation plan attached, and navigate budget\-constrained commercial conversations with confidence

**Executive Presence**
----------------------

* Engage consistently with senior\-level government and education stakeholders and communicate in terms that resonate in the public sector: compliance risk, audit efficiency, constituent accountability, and mission impact
* Equip internal executive sponsors with necessary context before high\-stakes customer conversations, including relevant legislative, regulatory, or political backdrop when appropriate

**Risk \& Issue Resolution**
----------------------------

* Identify risk themes by analyzing health trends, engagement signals, and relationship dynamics proactively, with an understanding that public sector accounts often have limited internal IT or change capacity to absorb issues
* Own escalations from identification through resolution: document the root cause, coordinate across functions, and keep the customer informed throughout

**Operational Excellence**
--------------------------

* Keep CRM records accurate and current, including renewal timelines, stakeholder maps, health scores, risk flags, and engagement recaps
* Share account patterns and SLED\-specific insights with your team and AE partners to build collective knowledge of what works in this market
* Act as the connective tissue for your account: bring in Solution Success, Product Success, Data Management, and Support at the right moment, so specialist engagement feels seamless to the customer

**What You'll Need**
====================

Minimum Qualifications


* 6\+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting, with experience managing government, higher education, or public sector accounts
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

  

Preferred Qualifications


* A track record of retaining and growing multi\-stakeholder accounts across multiple renewal cycles, including comfort navigating budget constraints and procurement processes
* Familiarity with SLED purchasing vehicles, fiscal year dynamics, and the regulatory environment that shapes how public sector organizations evaluate and adopt technology
* Commercial instincts calibrated to the public sector: you know how to build a business case that resonates with government buyers and how to work within the constraints they operate under
* The ability to read adoption and health data, identify what matters, and translate it into a clear account narrative and action plan
* Strong communication skills across organizational levels, from end users to department directors to executive sponsors
* Experience leading or coordinating cross\-functional work without direct authority, bringing together the right people across Sales, Support, Product, and other teams to drive outcomes
* CRM discipline that makes your forecasts reliable, your work visible, and your accounts transferable

**Travel Requirements \& Working Conditions**

* Willingness to travel up to 20% for team and corporate meetings, fostering relationships and representing company interests
* Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, as we embrace flexible work arrangements

**About Crossover Health**


Crossover Health is creating the future of health as it should be. A national, team\-based medical group with a focus on wellbeing and prevention that extends beyond traditional sick care, the company delivers an entirely new model of healthcare—Primary Health—built on the foundation of trusted relationships, an interdisciplinary care team approach, and outcomes\-based payment. Crossover’s Primary Health model integrates primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation and more, and delivers care in surround\-sound—in\-person, virtually and via asynchronous messaging. Together we are building a community of members that embraces healthcare as a proactive part of their lifestyle.

**About the role**



Point Digital Finance is expanding its Information Security function, and this is the team's first dedicated monitoring and response hire — a high\-visibility role with immediate, measurable impact. As Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection \& Response), you will be the second half of an incident\-response rotation, partnering directly with the security lead to detect, investigate, and contain threats across a regulated consumer\-finance environment that protects the financial data of hundreds of thousands of homeowners. This is not an alert\-watching seat: you will engineer the detections, automate the response, and harden how we see our AWS, Google Workspace, and SaaS estate. You'll help stand up a modern detection \& response practice from an early\-stage footing, with the autonomy to own problems end to end and the mandate to turn noisy alerts into fast, repeatable, well\-documented response. * **Engineer detections:** build, tune, and maintain SIEM detections, correlation rules, dashboards, and reporting in Coralogix across cloud and identity log sources.

* **Add operational redundancy:** serve as a redundant administrative and response path so containment is never bottlenecked on a single person.
* **Report and evidence:** produce recurring security metrics and reporting for leadership, and supply control evidence for audits.

**Nice to have**

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

We are looking for a strategic and analytical Revenue Operations Manager to join the Brands team at Roblox. * Document and systematize repeatable operational processes — from media plan intake to campaign pacing to client reporting.
* Identify bottlenecks across the Brands ops workflow and drive resolution in partnership with Product and Engineering.

--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. * Develop and enforce contact data standards, governance policies, and contact\-to\-account hierarchy rules aligned with global compliance requirements and regional privacy regulations

* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new contact systems, automation tools, and process changes; validate solutions meet global business requirements
* Participate in prioritization sessions to assess business impact of contact data initiatives and ensure resources are allocated to highest\-value opportunities
* Partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations, RevOps, Marketing Operations, and GTM teams to understand contact requirements and drive adoption of contact data standards
* Communicate contact data quality insights and strategic recommendations to Sales and C\-level GTM leadership through compelling presentations, dashboards, and executive reports
* Coordinate execution with central data governance team, regional stakeholders, and offshore contractors to deliver consistent, high\-quality contact data improvements
* Lead offshore team performance management, training, quality assurance, and process optimization
* Provide regular updates on contact data quality goals, progress against KPIs, improvements made, and impact to Sales effectiveness and revenue outcomes
* Prioritize contact data initiatives based on maximum business impact\-focusing resources and effort on high\-propensity accounts, priority segments, and activities with highest ROI to Sales prospecting, pipeline acceleration, and revenue growth
* Execute cross\-functional contact data programs with defined KPIs, milestones, and stakeholder visibility (contact segmentation, territory enablement, forecasting readiness)
* Support global GTM planning with clean, standardized, enriched contact data and account\-to\-contact mapping
* Establish contact data SLAs and achieve 98%\+ compliance across all regions; improve contact data accuracy to 95%\+ and achieve 90%\+ contact coverage within 12 months

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Thornton, CO, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management, business operations, or a related field.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with data analysis, utilizing metrics to track performance and drive decision\-making.
* Experience leveraging data analysis or AI tools to build dashboards, streamline business operations, and drive cross\-functional decision\-making.
* Experience in stakeholder management and executing communication strategies across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience independently managing the full lifecycle of cross\-functional programs with minimal guidance.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Global Infrastructure and Energy organization is responsible to deliver the infrastructure to host and connect every machine and every user on the internet, with Carbon Free Energy (CFE). As part of the Commercial and Business Operations arm within the Global Operations for Assets and Tooling team, we are responsible to help leadership run the business, and support the strategic negotiators land deals quickly and be able to maximize our returns.


As a Business Operations Program Manager, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and improving our team's daily operational rhythm. You will build and manage essential reporting dashboards, track various business and organization metrics, and leverage AI to improve our business operations. By providing steady support for ad hoc requests and standardizing processes, you will enable our team to operate at its highest potential.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $132000 \- $189000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain routine operational reports and dashboards to provide team leadership and stakeholders with clear visibility into key business metrics.
* Manage the internal team website and training materials, ensuring all resources, documentation, and processes are accurate, organized, and easily accessible.
* Track and reconcile approved headcount grants against open staffing requests, maintaining accurate roster data to support hiring workflows and capacity planning.
* Identify opportunities to streamline day\-to\-day business operations, leveraging AI tools and standardizing basic team processes to resolve bottlenecks.
* Provide ongoing support for daily operational tasks and ad hoc reporting requests, helping the team address immediate needs and maintain a steady operational rhythm.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. * Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
