new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.description:
**Meet Vestis®:** For the People Who Make It All Work
  
At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
  
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  

**Job Overview:**  

The Account Manager (AM) focuses on identifying and developing new product opportunities within the existing customer base. This role involves prospecting, presenting programs, and meeting sales quotas.
  
  

**Responsibilities/Essential Functions:**  

* The AM is expected to penetrate the current customer base and generate revenue through additional category adds – Uniforms, Workplace Supplies, Managed Restroom Services, First Aid and Direct Sales.
* The AM will also focus on securing contract renewals.
* Key responsibilities include documenting customer information, maintaining sales reports, and communicating product details to the service department.
* The AM is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with customers to drive sales and identify new opportunities.
* Drive a systematic sampling program that leads to proposal generation.
* As a direct report to the Sales Manager, this position will collaborate with the Sales and Operations teams to sell into the current customer base.


**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**  

* Must be customer oriented and able to communicate effectively
* Ability to provide a high quality service within a fast\-paced and physically challenging environment
* Goal driven and self\-motivated to include problem solving skills
* Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office applications (including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Internet/Intranet)


**Experience/Qualifications:**  

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s/Associates Degree preferred
* Prior experience in Route Sales and/or Business to Business (B2B) sales preferred


**License Requirements/Certifications:**  

* Valid Driver's License required


**Working Environment/Safety Requirements/Physical Requirements:**
  
Safely lift and carry up to 30 lbs consistently
  
**Compensation:** The salary rate that Vestis reasonably expects to pay for this position ranges from $85,000 \- $85,000, depending on circumstances including an applicant’s skills and qualifications, certain degrees and certifications, prior job experience, market data, and other relevant factors. Additional compensation may include a bonus or commission.
  
Vestis is an equal\-opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, relation, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.
  
  

Headquartered in Roswell, GA, Vestis® is the second largest provider in the industry with over 300,000 customer locations and approximately 20,000 teammates across North America. Vestis® is a leader in the B2B uniform and workplace supplies category. Vestis® provides clean and safe uniform services and workplace supplies to a broad range of North American customers from Fortune 500 companies to locally owned small businesses across a broad set of end markets. The Company’s comprehensive service offering includes a full\-service uniform rental program, cleanroom and other specialty garment processing, floor mats, towels, linens, managed restroom services, first aid supplies and more.
  
  

Vestis® is an equal\-opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, relation, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.

new_jobs.title: Legal Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**A World\-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data\-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. **The Role**

Palantir’s in\-house Legal team works to proactively address legal issues and enable the growth of our business so that Palantir can continue to drive positive impact in the world. Legal Operations is the backbone of the Legal team and is key to fulfilling Palantir’s mission. In that pursuit, we strive to cultivate Palantir's philosophy, develop relationships across the company, and operate with a service mindset. We develop a strong understanding of business strategy and have a passion for helping others, making us an invaluable resource. We’re a team that values both creativity and teamwork \- whether operating solo or collaboratively, we endeavor to achieve great results.  

  

As a Legal Operations Specialist, you will be the initial point of contact for operational questions and requests, providing guidance where appropriate and coordinating with the right Legal stakeholders. You will be responsible for executing on workflows as well as streamlining strategic processes and operational functions of the Legal team. You will also work closely with other Legal Operations teammates to help implement key systems, optimize processes, manage projects, and create objectives and performance metrics. You will partner your colleagues across Legal to understand the needs and develop and execute solutions that scale alongside the business. This position requires a combination of execution skills, project management, and process optimization.  

  

Our ideal candidate will take initiative, operate with discretion and resourcefulness, and thrive off of executing on and supporting the processes, systems and platforms of the Legal team. Most importantly, they have a true desire to be helpful and go above and beyond to solve challenges.
### **Core Responsibilities**

* Execute legal operational workflows and procedures as a first point of contact, looking for ways to continuously improve and drive efficiency
* Support execution of legal requests, including coordinating approvals, signatures, documentation, and other operational follow\-through
* Manage and triage incoming requests and correspondence for the Legal team, ensuring items are appropriately prioritized, routed, tracked, and resolved
* Scale the operations, systems, and ongoing innovation of the Legal team in partnership with existing Legal Operations leaders and teammates
* Craft and implement processes to reduce friction and enable team members, leaders, and business counterparts to spend time on what they do best
### **What We Value**

* Passion for legal operations and learning enterprise technology; energized by the challenges of serving a growing a team in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
* Demonstrated experience identifying and acting upon opportunities to improve processes and tools to enhance efficiency and drive results
* Experience building cross\-functional relationships with key resources and business partners across a legal team, advising, influencing decisions, managing change, and balancing multiple business function priorities
* Extraordinary judgment and composure in high\-pressure situations
* A creative approach to project management centered around lightweight frameworks that enable rapid iteration and low\-overhead methods
### **What We Require**

* 3\+ years of operational experience, preferably in a fast\-paced or dynamic legal team environment
* Experience with technical tooling and data analysis project management software
* Meticulous attention to detail, including maintaining accurate records and diligently tracking key project metrics
**Salary**

The salary range for this position is estimated to be $90,000 \- $110,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign\-on bonus and other potential future incentives. When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,

**About Renaissance**



When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre\-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one\-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.



Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.



**Job Description**



We believe that Customer Success is all about understanding your customers’ desired outcomes and working with them to ensure they experience the most value possible along the way. As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Renaissance, you are a part of the teacher and administrator journey through onboarding, nurturing, and renewal. The goal is to not only retain your customers, but to ensure that they have an exceptional experience with our platform(s) that drives successful student learning outcomes. This role manages District and School level accounts, and we are looking for you to drive successful implementations at scale while also achieving Renaissance’s business outcomes.


***Territory: This role covers a book of business that traverses multiple states. We ideally need someone located in the MST or PST time zone.***


**In this role as Customer Success Manager III, you will be responsible for:**


* Manage assigned portfolio customers with significant independence; Develop strategic customer relationships across territories and execute impactful strategies to drive strong business results
* Proactively and reactively ensure that customers are continuously delighted throughout their journey with Renaissance
* Partner with Sales to develop and execute account growth strategies across shared customers, leveraging deep customer insights to drive expansion opportunities within customer accounts
* Take ownership of risk identification, documentation, and escalation within their area. Apply customer and territory insights to ensure timely and accurate reporting of risks
* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross selling and work closely with the sales team to close any sales opportunities
* Lead complex customer success initiatives and serve as the escalation point for accounts, developing innovative solutions for sophisticated customer challenges
* Assist with product order queries and working with logistics team to resolve product order related issues
* Ensure that customers fully understand our product, benefits, and features
* Drive engagement and full adoption of our product and deployed hardware. Manage multiple tasks and higher levels of complexity
* Observe themes/ Gather feedback from customers and relay it to the product development team to enhance our product based on customer nee
* Monitor customer accounts and re\-actively address any signs of dissatisfaction or potential churn, taking measures to retain customers
* Guide new customers through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth transition and setup on our platform with 1:many communicati
* Independently drive customer strategies for personalized engagement
* Act as a mentor to internal teams as needed to set expectations around customer success management; Serve as a subject matter expert for customer success strategies and product support
* Develop strong product and industry knowledge to support customer success strategies and provide product\-related assistance; Contribute to thought\-leadership initiatives and support organizational presence at key customer and industry events as opportunities


**Qualifications**



**For this role as Customer Success Manager III, you should have:**


* 3\-5 years experience in Customer Success required
* Strong understanding of the K12 education competitive landscape
* Strong organizational, analytical and detail\-oriented thinking skills with the ability to operate in a highly efficient manner in a goal\-oriented environment
* Excellent CS strategy acumen with good business development and negotiating skills
* Strong interpersonal, written, presentation and oral communication skills
* Proven track record of meeting/exceeding goals and targets and delivering outcomes to customers


**Bonus Points**


* Experience within a SaaS education company


**Additional information**



Customer Success Managers at Renaissance are brought in as a CSM I, II, or III that is commensurate with experience. The level you are hired at will be determined by the interview and recruiting process. The job description is based on your book of business. Your title is based on your experience and background. All your information will be kept confidential.

* Tuition Reimbursement
* Life \& Disability Insurance
* Well\-being and Employee Assistance Programs

As a Senior Events Project Manager at Motive, you will help drive the execution of high\-impact event initiatives by bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to cross\-functional work. You will project manage various event formats—ranging from field marketing events to large\-scale trade shows—and lead key components of larger experiential initiatives, ensuring stakeholders stay aligned on scope, timelines, dependencies, and delivery expectations.



In this role, you will work across Marketing, Sales, and external vendors to keep priorities moving, surface risks early, and improve how event operations get done. The right candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable operating in a fast\-paced environment, and able to balance executional rigor with flexibility when event logistics or priorities evolve.

* Identify project risks, logistical blockers, and gaps in process early, and proactively drive resolution with the right internal partners and external vendors.
* Communicate event status, run\-of\-shows, decisions, and action items clearly so teams have the context needed to move work forward.
* Improve event management workflows, documentation, and team coordination practices to support more efficient event execution over time.

* 4\+ years of experience working in an event specialist or event project manager role at a B2B company.
* Background in managing high\-level cross\-functional trade shows, field events, corporate sponsorships, or virtual experiences.

new_jobs.description:
About ASL Communication

ASL Communication is an ASL interpreting agency. Sign language interpreting is the core of what we do and what we're known for, and we also provide spoken\-language interpreting, CART, and captioning across Nevada, Utah, and Colorado. We've been doing this since 2006, serving school districts, hospital systems, courts, universities, and government agencies.

We're a small team that treats interpreters as our most important customer, not just contractors we hire. Our reputation is built on filling assignments other agencies won't and doing right by the deaf, deaf\-blind, and limited\-English\-proficiency communities we serve. We're growing, and this role is central to how we grow well.

**About the role**

Our ability to fill interpreting assignments depends on one thing: having interpreters who are fully onboarded, properly credentialed and badged, accurately set up in our systems, and ready and willing to accept work. This role is responsible for making that happen.

As our Interpreter Concierge, you own each interpreter from the moment they're recruited to the moment they're ready to work, and you keep them ready after that. You're the connection between recruiting and scheduling, and you directly protect the near\-99% fill rate our clients count on.

This role rewards consistency and follow\-through, not adrenaline. If you love taking a proven process and running it cleanly every time, keeping dozens of details from slipping, and building real relationships with the people you support, you'll do well here.

**What you'll do**

**Support interpreter success.** From the moment an interpreter says yes to working with us, through their first assignment and beyond, you're their main point of contact. You make sure they're properly onboarded, set up correctly in our system, and ready to start seeing and accepting assignments.

**Own the onboarding pipeline.** Run our proprietary onboarding sequence ("Path to Partnership") and interpreter project boards. Move every new interpreter from recruited to documents complete to credentialed to badged to ready\-to\-work, with nothing stalling in between.

**Manage credentialing and badging.** Track RID certification and CEUs, state interpreter registry status, and the badge and tier requirements across our eight interpreting work categories. Assemble each interpreter's file so it's complete and decision\-ready. Run a standing audit of who's been badged and who hasn't, and work the gap list until it closes.

**Keep our systems accurate.** Own the accuracy of every interpreter's profile in our operations software: correct group placement, current availability, up\-to\-date credentials and work categories, and clear notes on badges and preferences that a scheduler can scan and act on. This data sits directly beneath our fill rate, so precision matters.

**Keep interpreters ready and equipped.** Flag lapsing credentials before they expire, nudge renewals, and keep availability current. Make sure active interpreters have what they need in hand, including business cards and feedback cards, and restock ahead of busy periods.

**Absorb the surges.** Onboard interpreters in batches through the same repeatable process during back\-to\-school and conference seasons, so growth never turns into a scramble.

**Communicate and support.** Own our recurring interpreter newsletter (credential deadlines, process changes, upcoming work, and recognition), and be the first point of contact helping interpreters get set up and navigate our self\-service portal. Support the interpreter workshops ASL Communication sponsors, and work with our leadership team and interpreter advisory committee to make sure projects that help interpreters actually get executed.

You'll partner closely with our scheduling and technology teams, who own matching interpreters to assignments and maintaining the software itself. Your lane is getting interpreters in the door, ready, and accurately represented in our systems.

**What we're looking for**

* You finish what you start. You're organized and systematic, and you keep a lot of moving pieces on track without being reminded.
* You're precise with data and documentation. Accuracy is a point of pride, not a chore.
* You're steady and dependable, and you genuinely like people. You build trust and rapport easily, and you're patient with the folks you support.
* You're comfortable living in software all day: CRMs, spreadsheets, project boards (we use Monday.com), and internal platforms you'll learn.
* You write clearly and warmly. A good chunk of this job is written communication with interpreters.
* You'd rather run a clean, repeatable system than improvise through chaos.

**Nice to have (not required):**

* Experience in language access, interpreting, or the ASL and deaf community
* Familiarity with RID certification, CEUs, or state interpreter and CART registries
* Experience in credentialing, provider enrollment, onboarding, or HR coordination
* Experience supporting 1099 contractors or freelancers
* Some ASL knowledge, or a willingness to learn, is welcomed. This is a coordination role, not an interpreting one.

Location, schedule, and pay

* **Location:** Fully remote. You can live anywhere, but you'll need to be available to work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific or Mountain time, which are our core business hours.
* **Schedule:** Full\-time.
* **Pay:** $25 per hour.
* **Benefits:** Vision, dental, a 401(k) plan, short\-term and long\-term disability, and paid time off (PTO).

**Why this role matters**

Every assignment we fill is someone getting access in a moment that matters: a medical appointment, a courtroom, a child's classroom. You'll be the reason interpreters are ready when those requests come in. It's operational work with a real human purpose behind it.

ASL Communication is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to an inclusive, accessible hiring process and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you
